66372.recognize_zh: 淡綠色背景下，左上角有一大團密集、深染、大小一致的小圓形至橢圓形菌體聚集（推測原本位於組織球內），周圍也散在少數單顆菌體；GMS 銀染讓小酵母菌凸顯，支持組織漿菌感染。
features: Dense cluster of numerous uniform, small round-to-oval dark-staining organisms (upper left), consistent with a yeast-laden histiocyte
Scattered single dark yeast forms throughout the smear
Light green counterstained background with red cell ghosts; host cell outlines are not well defined
Budding and precise size cannot be resolved at this low magnification; the organisms appear dark violet rather than jet black in this image
66372.describe_en: GMS-stained bone marrow aspirate smear viewed at low power shows a light green background with red cell ghosts. A dense aggregate of numerous small, uniform, round-to-oval silver-positive organisms is present in the upper left field, in keeping with a yeast-laden histiocyte, and scattered single organisms are seen elsewhere. Budding forms and exact size cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with disseminated small-yeast infection of the marrow, supporting Histoplasma capsulatum in the appropriate clinical and culture context.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are GMS-negative and show a kinetoplast on Giemsa, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are silver-positive.
Also GMS-positive small yeast, but shows elongated forms with a central transverse septum rather than narrow-based budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped and extracellular, and Candida glabrata is slightly larger with less uniform intracellular packing; culture or antigen testing resolves ambiguity.

66436.recognize_zh: 一顆形狀不規則的巨大組織球，細胞核偏在上方、體積小，細胞質豐富淡藍並呈纖細波紋條紋，像揉皺的面紙；和旁邊的小淋巴球相比非常大，符合高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Large histiocyte with an irregular, elongated outline, several times the size of the adjacent lymphocyte
Single eccentric nucleus at the upper pole with moderately condensed chromatin and no prominent nucleolus
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine wavy fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper appearance)
No foamy vacuoles, discrete granules, or ingested cells
Background small lymphocyte, a myeloid cell with an indented nucleus, and red cells with drying artifact
66436.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with an irregular, elongated outline among small lymphoid and myeloid cells; red cells show refractile drying artifact. The histiocyte has a small eccentric nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine, wavy fibrillary striations imparting a crumpled tissue paper appearance. No foamy vacuolation, ceroid granules, or hemophagocytosis is present. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, plasma cell myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Cannot be separated by morphology alone; the underlying disease, AFB stain, and normal glucocerebrosidase activity distinguish them.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely foamy, bubbly cytoplasm rather than wrinkled fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes show discrete blue-green granules instead of a striated cytoplasmic texture.

65668.recognize_zh: 這是一組流式細胞儀散點圖：紅色族群為 CD34+、HLA-DR 偏強、CD45 弱陽的異常骨髓母細胞，黑色族群為 CD117 強陽、HLA-DR 陰性的肥大細胞分化，綠色大族群為 CD203c+/CD123+、HLA-DR 陰性的嗜鹼性球；三群並存支持 CML 急性轉變合併明顯嗜鹼性球增生。
features: Multiparameter flow cytometry dot plots, color-coded populations (non-morphologic figure)
Red population: CD34-positive, HLA-DR bright, CD45 dim, CD7 positive, variable CD117 — abnormal myeloid blasts
Black population: CD117 bright, HLA-DR negative, CD203c partial/intermediate — mast cell–differentiated cells
Green population: CD45 moderate, CD123 positive, CD203c positive, HLA-DR negative, CD34 negative, CD117 negative — expanded basophils (gated)
Grey events: debris/non-viable or residual cells outside gates
65668.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the CSF specimen shows three color-coded populations. An abnormal myeloid blast population (red) expresses bright CD34, HLA-DR, dim CD45, CD123 and aberrant CD7, with variable CD117. A CD117-bright, HLA-DR-negative subset (black) indicates mast cell differentiation, and a dominant CD123+/CD203c+/HLA-DR− population with moderate CD45 (green) represents basophils. In the setting of known CML, the findings are consistent with extramedullary (CNS) myeloid blast phase with prominent basophilic and mast cell differentiation.

ddx.vs: pDCs are CD123 bright and HLA-DR positive with CD4 and CD56 but lack CD203c, whereas the green basophil population here is HLA-DR negative and CD203c positive.
Neoplastic mast cells are CD117 bright/CD203c+ but CD123 weak and lack a coexisting CD34+ myeloblast population, which is present here in a CML context.
Flow may look similar; distinction rests on BCR::ABL1 detection and prior CML history rather than immunophenotype.
Aberrant CD7 on myeloid blasts is common and insufficient; MPAL requires cytoplasmic CD3 (T) or MPO with lineage-defining B markers, which are not shown.

65860.recognize_zh: 這不是型態圖，而是血球計數儀的直方圖與散布圖：DIFF 散布圖中嗜中性球群（青綠色）明顯為最大族群，淋巴球群相對很少；WNB 圖也以白血球主群為主，符合嗜中性球增多。它提示需要推片複查，但本身無法區分真性或假性 Pelger-Huët。
features: RBC histogram: single unimodal peak centered near 80–90 fL within the discriminators
PLT histogram: peak around 5–10 fL with a tail that does not return to baseline toward the upper discriminator (possible large platelets or interference)
DIFF scattergram (SS vs FL): dominant, dense neutrophil cluster (cyan) with a small monocyte cluster (green) and very few lymphocytes/eosinophils
WNB scattergram: one dominant WBC cluster with a separate low ghost/debris cloud
No distinct abnormal cluster (e.g., blast or atypical lymphocyte region) is evident at this resolution
65860.describe_en: This figure is a hematology analyzer display (RBC and PLT histograms with DIFF and WNB scattergrams), not a morphologic image. The RBC histogram is unimodal and normocytic. The PLT histogram fails to return to baseline at the upper end, which may reflect large platelets or interference and warrants smear review. The DIFF scattergram is dominated by a dense neutrophil cluster with relatively few lymphocytes and a small monocyte population, supporting neutrophilia. The analyzer cannot assess nuclear segmentation, so the smear review showing bilobed neutrophils is what identified the pseudo-Pelger-Huët change in this reactive leukocytosis.

64708.recognize_zh: 單顆大型細胞的細胞質塞滿緻密的深紫紅色粗顆粒，顆粒佈滿整個細胞並遮蓋細胞核輪廓，看不到核仁或核旁淡染區；這種「顆粒遮核」的外觀是 APL 高顆粒性異常前骨髓細胞的教科書例子。
features: Single large cell, roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm completely packed with dense, coarse purple-red azurophilic granules
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus, whose outline is barely discernible
No visible nucleolus, perinuclear hof or Golgi zone
Auer rods not clearly identified in this cell
Background of normocytic red cells without other leukocytes
64708.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood shows a large cell whose cytoplasm is packed with dense, coarse azurophilic granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. No perinuclear hof or nucleolus is visible, and Auer rods are not clearly seen in this cell. The surrounding red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with a hypergranular abnormal promyelocyte of acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA.

ddx.vs: A basophil is smaller, has a segmented nucleus and dark purple-black granules that often wash out, rather than dense red-purple azurophilic granules.
Normal promyelocytes are confined to the marrow and show a visible round nucleus with a nucleolus and a clear perinuclear Golgi zone.
Mast cells have a round, centrally placed nucleus and metachromatic granules; they are tryptase and CD117 positive and CD34/MPO negative.
Toxic neutrophils have a clearly visible segmented nucleus with dark granules in a pale cytoplasm.

64836.recognize_zh: MGG 染色周邊血中，許多紅血球與三顆正染性紅血球母細胞（核小而濃縮）的細胞質內，可見細長針狀、絲狀、成束交錯的紫色包涵體；這種針狀結晶樣包涵體不同於點狀嗜鹼性斑點，配合明顯的紅血球大小形狀不一與多染性，提示紫質症相關的紅血球異常。
features: Numerous red cells with needle-like to filamentous basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions, singly or in tangled clusters
Similar inclusions in the cytoplasm of three orthochromatic erythroblasts with small pyknotic nuclei
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with irregular, folded, and fragmented red cell forms
Polychromasia with bluish-gray larger red cells
No leukocytes in this field
64836.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with polychromasia and three circulating orthochromatic erythroblasts. Many red cells and the erythroblasts contain striking needle-like and filamentous basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions, arranged singly or in tangled clusters, which differ from the punctate granules of basophilic stippling or Pappenheimer bodies. The nature of the inclusions cannot be established by morphology alone; in the appropriate clinical setting they are suggestive of a porphyria with erythroid involvement, such as congenital erythropoietic porphyria, and require confirmation with red cell and urine porphyrin studies, red cell fluorescence, and genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Basophilic stippling consists of fine or coarse punctate dots evenly distributed through the cell rather than needle-like filaments.
Pappenheimer bodies are small peripheral clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue, not elongated filaments.
Stain precipitate also lies between cells and in a different focal plane, whereas these inclusions are confined to red cells and erythroblasts.
HbC crystals are single dense rectangular or hexagonal bars that distort the cell, not thin tangled needles.

65604.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織被發炎細胞取代，其間可見數個邊界清楚、淡染的圓形上皮樣組織球結節（epithelioid granulomas），這就是骨髓肉芽腫的線索。
features: Multiple discrete, round, pale-staining nodules composed of epithelioid histiocytes within the intertrabecular space
Surrounding marrow replaced by a mixed inflammatory infiltrate with loss of normal fat and trilineage architecture
No definite central caseous necrosis identified at this low magnification
Bony trabeculae with fragmentation and tissue separation (processing artifact)
Low-power view limits assessment of giant cells and organisms
65604.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections at low power show bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces largely occupied by a mixed inflammatory infiltrate. Several discrete, well-circumscribed, pale epithelioid histiocytic aggregates consistent with granulomas are present. No definite caseating necrosis is seen at this magnification, and normal fat and hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced in the involved areas. Correlation with special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and clinical/serologic workup is required. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation of the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are small, contain fat vacuoles with scattered histiocytes and lymphocytes, and are incidental, whereas these are larger compact epithelioid granulomas within an inflamed marrow.
Hodgkin involvement shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic polymorphous background (CD30+/CD15+), not discrete epithelioid granulomas alone.
Infectious granulomas may be morphologically identical and are distinguished by AFB/GMS/PAS stains, cultures, and PCR, with necrosis favoring infection.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular/perivascular spindle-cell infiltrates with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive, unlike epithelioid histiocytes.

65284.recognize_zh: 中央一顆很大的細胞，核圓且染色質呈細緻均勻的顆粒狀，周圍有淡藍細胞質；右側與左下的細胞有深藍色細胞質與較粗的點狀染色質，背景為卵圓形紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性貧血中的前紅血球母細胞（megaloblastic proerythroblast）與早期紅系前驅細胞。
features: Very large central cell with a round nucleus and finely stippled, evenly dispersed open chromatin
Thin rim of pale grey-blue cytoplasm around the central cell, larger than neighboring cells
Adjacent early erythroid precursors with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and granular chromatin (right and lower left)
Small cell with pale blue cytoplasm at upper left and a disrupted cell at bottom center
Background red cells include oval macrocytes; smear edge with crush artifact at bottom
65284.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of erythroid precursors near the edge of a spread. The dominant cell is a large proerythroblast with a round nucleus containing finely stippled, open chromatin and a thin rim of pale cytoplasm; adjacent cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with granular chromatin, consistent with early erythroblasts. A disrupted cell and edge crush artifact are present, and background red cells include oval macrocytes. The enlarged size and open chromatin of the precursors are consistent with megaloblastic proerythroblasts in B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts lack the deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing of erythroid progenitors and are MPO-positive, while erythroid progenitors express CD71/E-cadherin/glycophorin.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets (>=30%) of vacuolated proerythroblasts, often with TP53 mutation, rather than a maturing megaloblastic erythroid series.
Parvovirus pronormoblasts have large glassy intranuclear inclusions with erythroid hypoplasia instead of hyperplasia.

65220.recognize_zh: 一顆嗜中性球的核分成約八個小圓葉，沿中心呈放射狀排成花冠或葡萄串狀，葉間以細染色質絲相連、中央留下淡染空隙，這就是葡萄狀核（botryoid nucleus），常與中暑、嚴重燒燙傷或古柯鹼/甲基安非他命使用有關。
features: Neutrophil-sized cell with a nucleus divided into multiple (about 7-8) small round lobes
Lobes arranged radially around a central pale zone in a rosette/grape-cluster pattern
Thin chromatin threads connecting the lobes toward the center
Dense, condensed chromatin within each lobe
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm without obvious toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells with mild crowding and a few platelets
65220.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a markedly abnormal nucleus composed of multiple small round lobes arranged radially around a central pale area and connected by fine chromatin strands, producing a botryoid (grape-cluster) configuration. The cytoplasm lacks prominent toxic granulation or vacuolization. Background red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality. The findings are consistent with a botryoid neutrophil, which should prompt evaluation for hyperthermia, severe burns or stimulant (cocaine/methamphetamine) exposure.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic hypersegmentation shows six or more lobes arranged linearly along a chromatin strand, not a radial rosette, with macro-ovalocytes.
Apoptotic neutrophils show discrete round pyknotic fragments without connecting chromatin threads and have dense eosinophilic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Radial segmentation in Sezary or flower-like lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Lymphoid flower cells have scant basophilic cytoplasm and lymphoid chromatin rather than neutrophilic cytoplasm.

65092.recognize_zh: 這是影像學圖而非切片：左為胸部增強 CT 軸切面、中為矢狀切面，藍色箭頭指前縱膈血管前區一個輕度顯影的軟組織腫塊；右為 PET-CT 融合影像，綠色箭頭顯示該病灶攝取 FDG。單一部位的縱膈腫塊是單中心性 Castleman 病常見表現，但確診仍需切除後病理。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT: mildly enhancing soft tissue mass in the prevascular (anterior) mediastinum (blue arrow)
Sagittal CT reformat: same well-circumscribed anterior mediastinal lesion anterior to the great vessels (blue arrow)
Axial fused PET-CT: FDG uptake localized to the anterior mediastinal lesion (green arrow)
No other enlarged lymph node stations are shown in these selected images
Figure includes an explanatory text caption beneath the images
65092.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic radiology figure. Axial and sagittal contrast-enhanced CT images demonstrate a mildly enhancing, well-circumscribed soft tissue mass in the prevascular region of the anterior mediastinum, and the fused PET-CT image shows that the lesion is FDG-avid. The findings indicate a solitary metabolically active mediastinal mass, which is a recognized presentation of unicentric Castleman disease but is radiologically nonspecific. Excision with histologic examination is required to distinguish it from thymic epithelial tumors and lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Thymic epithelial tumors arise in the same prevascular compartment and can be FDG-avid, so histology showing keratin-positive epithelial cells is needed for separation.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphomas are typically more intensely FDG-avid, often bulky or multistation, and require biopsy with CD30/CD15 or CD20/CD23 immunostaining.
Germ cell tumors may contain fat, calcification or cystic change and are associated with elevated AFP or beta-hCG.

65156.recognize_zh: 低倍抹片中充滿中等大小的母細胞樣細胞，細胞核圓至略不規則、染色質細緻，灰藍色細胞質常偏向一側形成「手鏡／尾巴」狀，部分周邊有小空泡，這種無顆粒的母細胞搭配皮膚病灶應考慮 BPDCN。
features: Markedly increased medium-sized blastoid cells dominating the nucleated cell population
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and high N:C ratio
Scant to moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm, often polarized to one side (hand-mirror/tail-like)
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles near the cell membrane
Few residual small lymphocytes and occasional nucleated red cells; no Auer rods or granules seen
65156.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-stained smear (likely peripheral blood, given the red cell monolayer and paucity of maturing granulocytes) shows a marked increase in medium-sized blastoid cells. The cells have round to mildly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, a high N:C ratio and scant to moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm that is frequently polarized, forming tail-like or hand-mirror extensions, with occasional small peripheral vacuoles. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. The morphology is that of an agranular blastic neoplasm and is not lineage-specific; with the CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ phenotype, findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes usually have more abundant cytoplasm, fine granules and folded nuclei with nonspecific esterase or MPO activity, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and cytochemically negative.
Lymphoblasts look similar but express cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT, which are negative in this case.
Sezary cells have cerebriform convoluted nuclei with condensed chromatin rather than the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

64964.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的卵圓形細胞，整個細胞質被密集的深紫黑色顆粒填滿，顆粒還溢出到細胞邊緣外，中央隱約可見單一圓核，這種單核、顆粒濃密到遮蓋核的外觀就是骨髓中的肥大細胞（mast cell）。
features: Two adjacent oval cells, larger than nearby lymphocytes
Single round-to-oval centrally placed nucleus, partially obscured by granules
Cytoplasm packed with dense, uniform, deep purple-black metachromatic granules
Granules extend to and slightly beyond the cell border, giving a fuzzy outline
Round/oval (not spindled) cell shape without hypogranularity or bilobed nuclei
Background of fibrillar stromal strands, red cells and small lymphoid cells
64964.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two oval cells with a single central round nucleus and cytoplasm densely packed with coarse, deep purple-black granules that partially obscure the nucleus and extend to the cell margin. The cells are round to oval rather than spindle-shaped, and there is no hypogranularity, nuclear lobation or clustering to suggest atypia. Surrounding stroma and scattered lymphoid cells are present. Findings are consistent with normal (typical) tissue mast cells in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a segmented/lobulated nucleus and fewer, larger water-soluble granules, whereas mast cells are mononuclear with densely packed smaller granules.

ddx.dx: Neoplastic mast cells in systemic mastocytosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mast cells are often spindle-shaped, hypogranular, with eccentric or bilobed nuclei and form aggregates, expressing CD25/CD2 and KIT D816V.
Siderophages have irregular coarse blue-black pigment of variable size, a more abundant cytoplasm and are Prussian blue positive.
Promyelocytes have finer azurophilic granules, a paranuclear hof and less dense granulation that does not obscure the nucleus.

64900.recognize_zh: 綠色箭頭標示的中型淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質均勻，胞質淡藍灰且邊緣呈毛絨狀突起（毛細胞）；藍色箭頭為核偏位、胞質豐富並具核周淡染區的漿細胞；背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and evenly dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, fluffy hair-like margins (hairy cells)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Rouleaux formation of background erythrocytes
Scattered small lymphocytes, a nucleated red cell, and a granulated cell at the edge
64900.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky-type stain, although labeled H&E by the submitter) shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm with irregular hair-like projections, consistent with hairy cells. A plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant basophilic cytoplasm is present nearby. The background shows prominent rouleaux formation, suggesting a serum paraprotein. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with a coexisting plasma cell population, supporting concurrent plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes of SMZL have short polar villi and more condensed chromatin, and lack CD25, CD123 and annexin A1.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells show a single prominent nucleolus, unlike the hairy cells here with inconspicuous nucleoli.
LPL shows a continuum of small lymphocytes to plasmacytoid cells rather than two separate populations of hairy cells and mature plasma cells.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm rather than round nuclei with circumferential fine projections.

64644.recognize_zh: 四格周邊血抹片比較不同淋巴球：格 1 為小而深染的圓形淋巴球，格 2 為核形不規則、細胞質邊緣不齊的小型反應性淋巴球，格 3 為染色質較開放、細胞質嗜鹼性邊緣明顯的大型反應性（免疫母細胞樣）淋巴球，格 4 為細胞質深藍、核偏位的漿細胞樣淋巴球。
features: Panel 1: small lymphocyte with dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm (reference or small reactive form)
Panel 2: small-to-medium lymphocyte with irregular nuclear contour and a ragged cytoplasmic border
Panel 3: large lymphocyte with moderately open, clumped chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm (immunoblast-like/Downey III-like)
Panel 4: medium lymphocyte with eccentric round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid lymphocyte)
Background erythrocytes show crenation (echinocytic artifact); low magnification limits nucleolar and granule assessment
64644.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear panels illustrate a spectrum of lymphocyte morphology. Panel 1 shows a small lymphocyte with a dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm; panel 2 shows a lymphocyte with an irregular nucleus and uneven cytoplasmic outline; panel 3 shows a larger lymphocyte with more open chromatin and a peripheral rim of deep basophilic cytoplasm; and panel 4 shows a plasmacytoid lymphocyte with an eccentric nucleus and intensely basophilic cytoplasm. Background red cells show crenation artifact. The relatively low magnification limits assessment of nucleoli, but the cells are consistent with reactive lymphocyte variants rather than blasts.

ddx.vs: Blasts have finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and a very high N:C ratio in a monotonous population, rather than a heterogeneous spectrum of reactive forms.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cells (e.g., mantle cell or Sézary cells)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells form a monomorphic population with a consistent abnormal nuclear shape (clefted, cerebriform), and clonality is confirmed by flow cytometry.
True plasma cells have clock-face chromatin and a distinct perinuclear hof with more abundant cytoplasm than plasmacytoid lymphocytes.
Monocytes are larger with folded lacy nuclei and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules rather than deeply basophilic cytoplasm.

64772.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓幾乎全被淡粉色、紡錘細胞為主的纖維化間質取代，其中散布許多深染的小上皮細胞巢，看不到正常造血與脂肪結構，是轉移癌廣泛取代骨髓的低倍型態。
features: Low-power view: extensive replacement of marrow spaces between bone trabeculae by pale fibrous (desmoplastic) stroma
Numerous small, irregular, darker-staining nests and cords of epithelial cells distributed throughout the stroma
Some nests with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggesting squamous differentiation
Near-total loss of normal hematopoietic tissue and fat cells in the field
Thin bone trabeculae without marked new bone formation
64772.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a pale desmoplastic stroma. Innumerable small, irregular nests and cords of epithelial cells, some with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, are dispersed throughout the fibrotic stroma, and normal hematopoietic marrow is not identified in this field. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. In the clinical context, the findings are consistent with extensive metastatic carcinoma, compatible with squamous cell carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other fibrotic myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows streaming atypical megakaryocyte clusters and dilated sinuses rather than cohesive nests of cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic lobular breast or signet-ring carcinoma
ddx.vs: These infiltrate as single files or dispersed single cells that are easy to miss, rather than discrete nests with eosinophilic squamoid cytoplasm.
Mast cell aggregates are composed of spindle to oval cells with clear cytoplasm that are CD117/tryptase positive and cytokeratin negative.

64324.recognize_zh: 視野下半部一顆大型巨噬細胞內塞滿數十顆大小一致、帶透明暈的小卵圓形酵母菌，部分也散在細胞邊緣，這種「巨噬細胞內滿載小酵母」的畫面是播散性組織胞漿菌症的典型表現。
features: Large macrophage packed with dozens of small, uniform oval yeasts (about 2-4 um)
Yeasts with a clear peripheral halo and an eccentric crescentic dark-staining nucleus
Occasional yeasts at the cell periphery or extracellular
Background marrow cells: erythroid precursors, granulocytic precursors, lymphocytes and a fat vacuole
Quick stain with brownish cast and thick areas limiting nuclear detail
64324.describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear with marrow cellularity shows a large macrophage filled with numerous small, uniform oval yeasts that have clear halos and eccentric crescent-shaped nuclear staining, with a few organisms at the cell periphery. The background contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors, lymphocytes and fat. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by GMS stain, culture and Histoplasma antigen testing is recommended, and HLH criteria should be assessed in this immunosuppressed patient.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a halo, whereas Histoplasma shows a single crescent nucleus with a halo.
Talaromyces divides by fission with a central septum and elongated forms, which are not seen here.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic or banana-shaped without halos, and are tightly packed within a pseudocyst.
Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy exudate and show intracystic bodies, rather than intracellular budding yeasts.

64388.recognize_zh: 數個中大型異常細胞，核呈明顯凹折、雙葉或似蝴蝶狀（bilobed/folded），細胞質淡藍、看不到粗大嗜天青顆粒，符合微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL, M3v）的外周血表現。
features: Medium to large abnormal cells, about 2-2.5 times red cell diameter
Nuclei irregular, folded to bilobed, some with a reniform or dumbbell contour
Finely granular chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm lacking visible coarse azurophilic granules
No Auer rods or faggot cells seen in this field
Red cells largely normocytic; platelets sparse
64388.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several abnormal medium to large mononuclear cells with moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm. The nuclei are markedly irregular, folded or bilobed, with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Cytoplasmic granules are not visible at the light microscopic level, and Auer rods are not identified in this field. Platelets appear decreased. Findings are suggestive of the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation by PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies is warranted.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with delicate folded nuclei too, but APL-v cells are strongly and diffusely MPO-positive, CD34/HLA-DR negative, and carry PML::RARA.
Classic APL cells show dense coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, whereas these cells appear agranular by light microscopy.
Sezary cells have scant agranular cytoplasm and dense convoluted chromatin with CD4+ T-cell phenotype, not the fine chromatin and moderate cytoplasm of promyelocytic blasts.
Normal monocytes have vacuolated gray cytoplasm and lacy mature chromatin and are MPO weak with CD14 expression, lacking the immature fine chromatin and abnormal bilobation.

64132.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁緊鄰排列多顆巨核細胞，核深染、呈雲朵狀或團塊狀（hyperchromatic, cloud-like），部分位於擴張的竇狀隙中並成小群聚，背景細胞增生，符合原發性骨髓纖維化的異常巨核細胞分布。
features: Megakaryocytes abnormally located adjacent to the bony trabecula (paratrabecular) and clustered
Megakaryocyte nuclei hyperchromatic with bulbous, cloud-like, or irregularly clumped lobation
Several megakaryocytes lying within dilated sinusoidal spaces (intrasinusoidal)
Variation in megakaryocyte size with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and a loose, slightly streaming stroma
64132.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula. Megakaryocytes are increased and abnormally positioned, forming loose clusters in the paratrabecular region and within dilated sinusoids. They vary in size and show hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei. The intervening marrow shows granulocytic proliferation with a mildly loosened, streaming stroma. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with atypical megakaryocytes, supportive of primary myelofibrosis in the clinical context; reticulin and trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, loosely dispersed rather than tightly paratrabecular, in a normocellular marrow without significant fibrosis.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic but mostly normally lobated megakaryocytes and prominent erythroid hyperplasia.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated, or separated-lobed (micromegakaryocytes) with dysplasia in other lineages rather than bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but maintain normal morphology and do not cluster tightly along trabeculae.

64068.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片：兩隻大腳趾的甲溝（nail fold）邊緣可見紅色、濕潤結痂的肉芽樣組織與輕度紅腫，左側大腳趾外側甲溝最明顯，符合 ibrutinib 相關的甲周肉芽腫（periungual granuloma）或甲溝炎表現。
features: Clinical photograph of both great toes
Left great toe: linear red, moist, crusted granulation-like tissue along the lateral nail fold with mild surrounding erythema
Right great toe: smaller erythematous, crusted lesion at the medial nail fold
Nail plates intact without discoloration, onycholysis or subungual hemorrhage
No purulent discharge, vesicles or ulceration of the digit pulp visible
64068.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows both great toes with erythematous, moist and crusted granulation-like tissue along the lateral nail fold of the left great toe and a smaller similar lesion at the medial nail fold of the right great toe. There is mild periungual erythema without obvious purulence, and the nail plates appear otherwise intact. This is a clinical rather than microscopic image, so histologic confirmation is not available here. In a patient on ibrutinib, findings are consistent with drug-associated periungual pyogenic granuloma-like lesions/paronychia.

ddx.vs: Ingrown nails are usually unilateral with a lateral nail spicule embedding in the fold and a mechanical history, whereas bilateral lesions on a kinase inhibitor favor drug toxicity.
Infectious paronychia shows purulence, fluctuance or cuticle loss with positive cultures, rather than dry crusted granulation tissue.

ddx.dx: Retinoid or EGFR inhibitor-induced periungual pyogenic granuloma
ddx.vs: These are clinically identical and are distinguished only by drug exposure history.

ddx.dx: Subungual/periungual squamous cell carcinoma or amelanotic melanoma
ddx.vs: Malignancy is usually solitary, persistent and destructive of the nail, and would require biopsy if lesions do not resolve after drug-related management.

64004.recognize_zh: 這不是電泳膠片，而是 Bio-Rad 高效液相層析（HPLC）的色譜圖：主峰為約 2.3 分鐘的 HbA0，約 3.6 分鐘處有明顯的陰影 HbA2 峰，標題說明為 HbA2 升高，提示 β 地中海型貧血帶因者；百分比數字在此圖解析度下無法判讀。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram (Bio-Rad system) with absorbance versus retention time (0-6 min)
Dominant off-scale HbA0 peak at approximately 2.3 min
Shaded HbA2 peak at approximately 3.6 min, visually prominent relative to baseline
Small early-eluting peaks (approximately 1.1-1.8 min) corresponding to HbF, P2/P3, and glycated fractions
No abnormal variant peak (e.g., HbS or HbC window) is evident; peak percentage table is not shown
64004.describe_en: The figure shows a cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) tracing rather than a conventional electrophoresis gel. There is a dominant HbA0 peak at approximately 2.3 minutes, small early-eluting minor fractions, and a shaded HbA2 peak at approximately 3.6 minutes. No abnormal variant peaks are identified in the S or C windows, and the numeric peak table is not included, so the HbA2 percentage cannot be verified from the image. Per the submitted history of increased HbA2 (typically >3.5%), findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia trait, to be correlated with red cell indices and iron status.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency lowers HbA2 and can mask beta-thalassemia trait, so HbA2 should be interpreted with ferritin; it does not raise HbA2.
Alpha-thalassemia trait has normal or low HbA2 on HPLC and requires DNA testing for confirmation.

ddx.dx: HbE or Hb Lepore co-eluting in the A2 window
ddx.vs: HbE co-elutes with HbA2 on many HPLC systems giving a falsely very high A2 (typically >10%), distinguished by capillary electrophoresis or DNA analysis.
Delta-beta thalassemia shows markedly increased HbF with normal or low HbA2, unlike an isolated HbA2 elevation.

63812.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球中有大量「牛眼狀」標靶細胞（target cells）：外圈血紅素、中間淡染環，正中央又有一團血紅素；同時紅血球偏小、淡染且大小形狀不一，在 β 型重度地中海貧血孩童的血片中是典型表現。
features: Numerous target cells (codocytes) with a central dot of hemoglobin surrounded by a pale ring and a peripheral hemoglobinized rim
Red cells predominantly small and hypochromic
Anisopoikilocytosis with oval, teardrop-like and irregular forms
Target cells evenly distributed across the field, favoring a true finding over drying artifact
Part of a granulocyte at the lower edge; image is out of focus, limiting assessment of inclusions such as basophilic stippling
63812.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells distributed evenly across the field, together with microcytic, hypochromic red cells and moderate anisopoikilocytosis including oval and teardrop-like forms. The image is somewhat out of focus, so basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells and other inclusions cannot be reliably assessed. A portion of a granulocyte is seen at the lower margin. Findings are consistent with a thalassemic red cell disorder such as beta-thalassemia major, as reported, and hemoglobin fractionation is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbC disease shows target cells with spherocytes and HbC crystals and HbE shows milder microcytosis, both identified by an abnormal variant on HPLC or electrophoresis rather than the high HbF of beta-thalassemia major.
Liver disease produces normocytic or macrocytic target cells from membrane lipid gain, without microcytosis, hypochromia or marked poikilocytosis.
Asplenia shows target cells with Howell-Jolly bodies, acanthocytes and Pappenheimer bodies in a normocytic background.
Artifactual targets from slow drying or humidity are unevenly clustered in thick areas of the smear, whereas the targets here are uniformly distributed with accompanying microcytosis.

63748.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色幾乎整片陽性（瀰漫性 B 細胞浸潤），CD138 顯示散在成群的漿細胞；輕鏈染色 kappa 大片陽性而 lambda 僅零星陽性，呈現 kappa 輕鏈限制性，符合伴隨漿細胞分化的單株性 B 細胞淋巴瘤（淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: CD20: diffuse, near-confluent positivity replacing the marrow space
CD138: increased scattered and clustered plasma cells interspersed within the B-cell infiltrate
Kappa: strong, diffuse staining (cytoplasmic plus background) highlighting the plasmacytic component
Lambda: only rare scattered positive cells, indicating kappa light-chain restriction
Low-power views with bony trabeculae and fat spaces
63748.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the bone marrow core biopsy show a diffuse infiltrate of CD20-positive B cells effacing the marrow space. CD138 highlights increased plasma cells present singly and in clusters within the infiltrate. Kappa in situ/immunostaining is diffusely positive, whereas lambda marks only rare scattered cells, indicating kappa light-chain restriction of the plasmacytic component. Findings indicate a clonal B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation and, together with morphology and MYD88 L265P, are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma. Kappa staining shows some background signal, which should be interpreted with care.

ddx.vs: MZL shares CD20+ B cells with monotypic plasma cells; distinction relies on clinical presentation, nodular/intrasinusoidal pattern and MYD88 status rather than this immunoprofile.
Myeloma shows sheets of light-chain-restricted CD138+ plasma cells without a diffuse CD20+ B-cell component.

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasmacytosis with lymphoid aggregates
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a normal kappa:lambda ratio (about 2:1) and B cells form small non-destructive aggregates.

63684.recognize_zh: 印片（imprint smear）中滿布小而圓、核深染、細胞質極少的成熟淋巴球，其間夾雜少數較大、染色質較鬆散、細胞質較多的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），另有散在的分葉核中性球作為大小對照。
features: Dense population of small mature lymphocytes with round, condensed nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Interspersed larger cells with more open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Scattered band and segmented neutrophils serving as size references
Cellular imprint with interspersed fat spaces
Strong magenta color cast and limited focus obscure nucleoli and fine chromatin detail
63684.describe_en: Imprint smear shows a hypercellular preparation dominated by small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm. A minority of larger lymphoid cells with more open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, are interspersed, together with scattered band and segmented neutrophils. The magenta color cast and image focus limit evaluation of nucleoli and chromatin pattern. Findings are consistent with a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; immunophenotyping is required for classification.

ddx.vs: MCL cells tend to have irregular notched nuclei and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, requiring immunostains or FISH for t(11;14) to separate from CLL.
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes have granular cytoplasm and indented nuclei, whereas the dominant cells here are agranular lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

63620.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被成片、胞質淡粉紅帶條紋的組織球取代，類似 Gaucher 細胞；高倍下少數組織球內有折光性橘紅色菱形結晶，其間夾雜小群漿細胞，應想到結晶儲積組織球增生症（crystal-storing histiocytosis）並追查背後的漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, fibrillary/striated cytoplasm replacing most of the marrow space
Small, bland, oval to irregular histiocyte nuclei with low N:C ratio
Occasional refractile, orange-pink intracytoplasmic rhomboid crystalline inclusions (panel B, green arrows)
Small interstitial clusters of darker mononuclear cells (plasma cells per history) between histiocytes (panel A, green arrows)
Markedly reduced residual hematopoiesis and scattered fat spaces; bony trabeculae at top and bottom of panel A
63620.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is largely effaced by diffuse sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale pink, striated cytoplasm, imparting a Gaucher-like appearance. At high power, occasional histiocytes contain refractile, eosinophilic rhomboid crystalline inclusions. Small clusters of plasma cells are interspersed between the histiocytes and are easily overlooked on H&E; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are required to demonstrate the clonal population. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a kappa-restricted plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma).

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without refractile rhomboid crystals and lack an accompanying clonal plasma cell population, whereas CSH crystals are immunoglobulin light chain (usually kappa) deposits.
Mycobacterial histiocytes lack crystals and contain acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain, often with granulomas.
The striated-appearing cells of CSH are CD68/CD163-positive histiocytes, not desmin/myogenin- or S100-positive cells.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a/langerin-positive with eosinophils, and ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD1a- histiocytes with BRAF V600E and fibrosis, neither containing light-chain crystals.

63556.recognize_zh: 視野中有數顆核偏心、胞質深藍且有核周淡區的漿細胞，旁邊散在一群均質、圓形、呈藍綠色的球狀物，是細胞外沉積的免疫球蛋白小體（extracellular immunoglobulin globules）。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one large binucleate-appearing form with a paranuclear hof
Plasma cell with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus, larger than a mature plasma cell
Clusters of round, homogeneous, glassy blue-green globules lying free outside cells, consistent with extracellular immunoglobulin
Clear round vacuole-like spaces adjacent to plasma cells
Background marrow with neutrophils, a promyelocyte/myelocyte, and erythrocytes; proteinaceous blue-grey background
63556.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa, 100x oil) shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing, including enlarged forms with abundant cytoplasm. Adjacent to the cluster are several round, homogeneous, refractile blue-green globules lying extracellularly, consistent with extruded immunoglobulin (Russell body-like material). Maturing granulocytes and erythrocytes are present in the background on a proteinaceous blue-grey ground substance. Quantification of plasma cells cannot be performed from a single field. Findings indicate plasma cells with immunoglobulin inclusion formation; correlation with plasma cell percentage, light chain restriction and serum paraprotein is required to distinguish reactive plasmacytosis from a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Mott cells with intracellular Russell bodies
ddx.vs: Mott cell globules are confined within an intact plasma cell cytoplasm around the nucleus, whereas these globules lie free outside cells.
Crystal-storing histiocytosis shows histiocytes packed with elongated needle or rhomboid crystals rather than free round globules.
Stain precipitate is irregular, dark and lies in a different focal plane, while these globules are uniform, round and homogeneous and associate with plasma cells.

63492.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，幾乎所有密集排列的圓形細胞都呈強而瀰漫的棕色細胞質／膜染色，只留下中央藍色細胞核，代表浸潤細胞一致表現該抗原；標記名稱未標示，要配合其他染色判斷系別。
features: Dense sheets of round cells with round central nuclei
Strong, diffuse brown cytoplasmic/membranous staining in the vast majority of cells
Uniform staining pattern suggesting a monotonous positive population
Nuclei spared with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Marker not identified; tissue fragmented with empty spaces
63492.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy shows a densely cellular infiltrate in which nearly all cells demonstrate strong, diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous brown staining with sparing of the nuclei. The uniformity of staining indicates that the infiltrating population expresses the antigen tested. The antibody is not specified, so the lineage implication cannot be stated from the image alone. In the context of acute leukemia with focal coagulative necrosis, this pattern would support a lineage-defining marker expressed by the blast population, pending correlation with the full panel.

ddx.vs: Diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD79a, CD19, or CD10 staining with nuclear TdT and PAX5 would support B-lineage blasts.
Diffuse cytoplasmic MPO or CD117/CD33 positivity with absence of B-lineage markers would indicate myeloid lineage.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli that are CD20+ but TdT and CD34 negative would favor a mature B-cell lymphoma.

63300.recognize_zh: CD3/CD5 散佈圖中，閘門 R 內有一大群 CD5 強陽性但表面 CD3 陰性的藍色細胞，和右上方 CD3+CD5+ 的正常 T 細胞（紅色）分開；這種表面 CD3 陰性（sCD3−）的 T 細胞族群是淋巴球型 HES 的典型免疫表型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot: CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD5-PB (y-axis), panel C
Gated population R (blue): bright CD5 expression with absent surface CD3
Normal T cells (red) are CD3-bright and CD5-positive
Small green population with CD3 positivity and dimmer CD5
Orange CD3-negative, CD5-negative events (B/NK cells) and scattered purple events near the origin
63300.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD3 versus CD5 demonstrates a large, discrete population (gate R, blue) that expresses bright CD5 but lacks surface CD3, clearly separated from the normal CD3+CD5+ T cells (red) and the CD3-/CD5- non-T lymphocytes (orange). Combined with the CD4-positive, CD7-negative profile shown in the companion plots, this surface CD3-negative T-cell population is an aberrant immunophenotype. Findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are also CD3-negative and CD5-positive but co-express CD19, CD20 (dim) and CD23 with light-chain restriction, and are CD5 dim rather than T-cell bright; B-cell markers resolve this.
Another CD5+CD3- population, but it is a B-cell neoplasm (CD19+, CD20 bright, cyclin D1+) rather than a CD4+ T-cell population.
Sezary cells are usually surface CD3-positive (sometimes dim) CD4+CD7-/CD26- with cutaneous disease, whereas complete surface CD3 loss with hypereosinophilia favors lymphocytic HES.

63236.recognize_zh: 切片中央可見一個嗜伊紅性、玻璃樣化的小結節，周圍的小淋巴球呈同心圓排列，背景是瀰漫的小淋巴球及間質中許多玻璃樣化的小血管；萎縮、玻璃樣化的生發中心加上間質血管增生，是 Castleman 病的線索。
features: Small atretic follicle with a central eosinophilic, hyalinized germinal center (center of field)
Small lymphocytes arranged concentrically around the hyalinized center
Diffuse sheets of small lymphocytes with admixed cells that may include plasma cells (not resolvable at this power)
Numerous interfollicular small vessels with hyalinized, eosinophilic walls
Focal black pigment/debris adjacent to the follicle, likely artifact or pigment deposit
63236.describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue shows a small atretic follicle with a hyalinized, eosinophilic germinal center surrounded by concentrically arranged small lymphocytes. The interfollicular region contains diffuse small lymphocytes and prominent small vessels with hyalinized walls. Focal black pigment near the follicle is likely artifactual. Although the stated magnification is x400, cellular detail is limited in this image, so plasma cell content and HHV-8-positive plasmablasts cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease with regressed, hyalinized germinal centers; LANA-1 (HHV-8) immunostaining and clinical correlation are needed to classify the disease as multicentric and HHV-8-associated.

ddx.vs: Shows identical regressed follicles and hyalinized vessels, so distinction from MCD depends on clinical extent (single site) and HHV-8 negativity.
Can show involuted, hyalinized germinal centers with vascular proliferation, but occurs in HIV-positive patients with follicle lysis and lacks sheets of plasma cells.
May have Castleman-like follicles, but features increased IgG4+ plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%), often with eosinophils and elevated serum IgG4.
Shows regressed follicles and prominent high endothelial venules but also atypical clear T cells with a TFH phenotype and expanded follicular dendritic meshworks around vessels.

63172.recognize_zh: 幾乎所有紅血球表面都有不規則的淡染缺損、像被蟲蛀的「凹洞」（pitted surface），邊緣呈扇貝狀或不規則，這是冷沉球蛋白（cryoglobulin）沉積在紅血球上造成的人工假象，而不是真正的紅血球異形。
features: Nearly all red cells show irregular pale, punched-out or moth-eaten areas on their surface
Irregular, scalloped red cell outlines without true spicules
No discrete basophilic inclusions or parasites within the pale areas
Occasional small platelets; one large pale finely granular structure (possible precipitate or degenerated cell)
Leukocytes absent in this field
63172.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a diffuse, uniform artifact in which almost all red cells display irregular pale pitted or moth-eaten surface defects with scalloped outlines. No intraerythrocytic parasites, basophilic stippling or discrete inclusions are identified within the defects. Similar changes affecting virtually every red cell point to a preparation-related rather than intrinsic red cell abnormality. In a patient with type 1 cryoglobulinemia, findings are consistent with cryoglobulin precipitate artifact; preparing a smear from a pre-warmed (37 C) sample is recommended to confirm.

ddx.vs: Water artifact produces refractile, sharply outlined bubbles that shift with focus and is not linked to cold, whereas cryoglobulin artifact resolves on warming the sample.
Echinocytes have regular, evenly spaced short projections around the circumference rather than irregular pale pits across the cell surface.
Parasites show discrete chromatin dots with cytoplasm (rings), whereas these pale defects lack chromatin or defined structure.
Acanthocytes are dense spheroidal cells with few irregular long spicules and no central pitting.

63108.recognize_zh: CD68 在右側病灶的內襯細胞與腔內脫落細胞團呈強陽性（顆粒狀），左側白髓淋巴球為陰性；病灶細胞帶有組織球標記，這是 littoral cell angioma 的特徵之一。
features: Strong granular cytoplasmic CD68 staining in lesional lining cells (right)
Cluster of large, intensely CD68-positive desquamated cells within a blood-filled lumen
Adjacent white pulp lymphoid tissue (left) is CD68-negative except for rare histiocytes
Lesional area shows anastomosing channels with plump positive cells
Blood-filled cystic space in upper field
63108.describe_en: CD68 immunostain of spleen shows strong granular cytoplasmic staining of the cells lining the vascular channels of the lesion, as well as a cluster of large, intensely positive cells shed into a blood-filled lumen. The adjacent white pulp is essentially negative. Expression of the histiocytic marker CD68 in the lining cells supports the dual endothelial-histiocytic phenotype of littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma lining cells are CD31+/CD34+ but lack CD68 and CD163 expression.
HLH shows scattered CD68+ hemophagocytic macrophages in cords and sinuses without a mass-forming vascular lesion lined by CD68+ cells.
LCH cells are CD1a+/langerin+/S100+ with grooved nuclei and form infiltrates rather than lining vascular channels.

63044.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則且互相吻合成網狀，骨髓腔被疏鬆的纖維血管性結締組織取代、造血細胞稀少，符合 Paget 骨病的骨重塑異常。
features: Markedly increased bone volume with thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae
Trabecular surfaces with irregular scalloped outlines
Marrow spaces replaced by loose fibrovascular connective tissue with sparse hematopoietic cells
Overall hypocellular marrow; no tumor cell clusters appreciated at this magnification
Mosaic cement lines and osteoclast detail cannot be assessed at this low power
63044.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows markedly increased bone mass composed of thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae with scalloped contours. The intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by loose fibrovascular connective tissue, and hematopoietic elements are sparse. No metastatic tumor is evident at this magnification, although higher power is needed to assess osteoclasts and cement lines. In conjunction with sclerotic lesions and elevated alkaline phosphatase, findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial clusters within desmoplastic stroma that are keratin (and PSA/NKX3.1) positive, which are not seen here.
Hyperparathyroid bone shows dissecting (tunneling) resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis without the mosaic cement-line pattern, and has abnormal PTH/calcium.
Primary myelofibrosis has clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin/collagen fibrosis within a hematopoietic marrow, rather than vascular connective tissue with hypocellularity.

62916.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中同時可見兩群細胞：一群核質比高、染色質細緻、有核仁、細胞質少的母細胞，另一群核偏位、細胞質深藍、有核周淡染區（hof）的漿細胞；母細胞與大量漿細胞並存，是這個「T 淋巴母細胞白血病合併反應性漿細胞增多」病例的重點。
features: Numerous intermediate-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Blast nuclei round to slightly irregular with scant pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm
Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm, and perinuclear hof
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a few maturing myeloid cells
A large round cell with granular purple rim at lower right, of uncertain nature at this resolution
Cellular aspirate with background platelet and cell debris
62916.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous intermediate-to-large blasts having high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Admixed are increased mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs, along with occasional small lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells. A large cell with a granular purple rim at the lower right cannot be characterized at this resolution. With the reported 36% blasts of T lineage (cCD3+, TdT+) and polyclonal CD38+ plasma cells, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with concurrent leukemia
ddx.vs: Myeloma plasma cells are often atypical (binucleation, nucleoli) with light-chain restriction and an M-protein, whereas here plasma cells are polyclonal with polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia.
Plasmablasts are large with prominent central nucleoli and CD138/MUM1 positivity but lack TdT and cCD3.
AML blasts may show granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD117 positive, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative with cCD3 and TdT expression.
Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, autoimmune disease, HIV) lacks a TdT-positive blast population.

62852.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片上兩群中型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，多顆芽細胞核內可見淡色的杯狀凹陷（cup-shaped nuclear invagination），細胞質少、無顆粒，是 NPM1/FLT3-ITD 突變 AML 常見的杯狀芽細胞。
features: Two clusters of medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine chromatin; several with a pale central nuclear invagination (cup-like)
Scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
One disrupted cell with coarse granular cytoplasm and a small lymphocyte nearby
Background red cells with occasional teardrop forms and platelet clumps
62852.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts display a pale nuclear invagination producing a cup-shaped or fish-mouth nuclear appearance. Auer rods are not seen; a smudged granular cell and a small lymphocyte are also present, and the background contains occasional teardrop red cells and platelet clumps. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, which in this patient was AML with mutated NPM1 and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL blasts have bilobed or reniform nuclei with fine granules and strong MPO, and carry PML::RARA.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity rather than a discrete cup-shaped invagination.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and lymphoid-marker positive, although cup-like nuclei can occasionally occur.

62788.recognize_zh: 這是PCR-RFLP的聚丙烯醯胺凝膠電泳：野生型VHL經Fnu4HI切割成187 bp與81 bp，而一個檢體只出現未切割的268 bp條帶，代表同型合子VHL c.598C>T（Chuvash polycythemia）。
features: Polyacrylamide gel with a DNA size marker lane (M) and seven sample lanes
One sample shows a single uncut 268 bp band, indicating loss of the Fnu4HI restriction site on both alleles (homozygous VHL c.598C>T)
Remaining samples show the digested 187 bp band with a faint 81 bp band, the wild-type pattern
No lane shows all three bands (268, 187, 81 bp), so no heterozygote is evident in this gel
Lane number labels appear offset relative to the lanes; interpretation follows the figure legend
62788.describe_en: Polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis of a PCR-RFLP assay for the VHL c.598C>T variant is shown with a molecular size marker. Most sample lanes display the 187 bp and faint 81 bp fragments generated by Fnu4HI digestion of the wild-type 268 bp amplicon. One lane shows only the undigested 268 bp product, indicating homozygous loss of the restriction site. Heterozygotes would display all three bands, and none is evident here. Findings are consistent with homozygosity for VHL c.598C>T (p.Arg200Trp), the Chuvash polycythemia variant, in the index sample; note that lane labels appear misaligned with the lanes in this figure.

ddx.vs: Partial digestion would leave a 268 bp band together with 187/81 bp fragments in the same lane and would be flagged by a digestion control, whereas the homozygous lane shows the uncut band alone.
Carriers show all three bands (268, 187 and 81 bp) rather than a single 268 bp band.

ddx.dx: Other congenital erythrocytosis variants (EPOR, EGLN1, EPAS1)
ddx.vs: These are not detected by this Fnu4HI RFLP and require sequencing; their wild-type VHL pattern would be fully digested.

62724.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一群中大型細胞的核呈雙葉或蝴蝶狀凹折、胞質幾乎看不到顆粒，其中一顆可見 Auer rod（紅箭頭），背景有破碎紅血球（黑箭頭），是微顆粒型急性前骨髓球性白血病（APL, microgranular variant）的典型表現。
features: Medium to large leukemic cells with bilobed, folded, or butterfly-shaped nuclei
Hypogranular to agranular pale basophilic cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Auer rod within one abnormal promyelocyte (red arrow)
Fine nuclear chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Schistocytes in the background (black arrows), consistent with DIC
62724.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium to large abnormal cells with bilobed, reniform, or butterfly-shaped nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate amounts of hypogranular pale blue cytoplasm. An Auer rod is identified in one cell (red arrow). Scattered schistocytes are present in the background (black arrows), and platelets are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation monitoring are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes also have folded nuclei but show gray-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles, are strongly nonspecific esterase-positive, and are typically HLA-DR-positive, whereas microgranular APL is strongly MPO-positive and HLA-DR/CD34-negative.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse azurophilic granules and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells), while the microgranular variant has near-agranular cytoplasm with bilobed nuclei and a high WBC.
NPM1-mutated AML may show nuclear invaginations and HLA-DR/CD34 negativity, so RT-PCR or FISH for PML::RARA is required to separate them.
Mature monocytes have abundant gray cytoplasm with fine granules and condensed lacy chromatin, without Auer rods or schistocytes with coagulopathy.

62660.recognize_zh: 掃描倍率下為一整顆淋巴結，被膜完整、周圍有脂肪，實質內可見許多小濾泡與生發中心，整體架構大致保留；在這個倍率下看不出腫瘤細胞，需要高倍或 HHV8 染色才能看到竇內的大型細胞。
features: Entire oval lymph node with intact fibrous capsule and perinodal adipose tissue
Largely preserved architecture with numerous small follicles and germinal centers
Some follicles appear small or regressed with prominent mantle zones
Subtle sinus pattern; no mass-forming effacement at scanning power
Linear cutting/folding artifacts across the section
62660.describe_en: Scanning-power H&E section shows an entire lymph node with an intact fibrous capsule and perinodal fat. The nodal architecture is largely preserved, with numerous small follicles, some with small or regressed germinal centers, and no mass-forming effacement. Sinusoidal involvement by large neoplastic cells is not resolvable at this magnification, and linear sectioning artifacts are present. This field alone would not suggest lymphoma; the diagnosis of extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma relies on higher-power identification of large cells within sinuses and HHV8 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Similar preserved architecture at low power; lacks sinusoidal clusters of large HHV8-positive cells at higher power.
Shows regressed follicles with expanded mantle zones and interfollicular plasma cells, with HHV8-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones rather than sinus sheets.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, sinusoidal pattern
ddx.vs: Can also spare architecture at low power; large cells are CD30/ALK or T-cell positive and HHV8-negative.

62596.recognize_zh: 胸部電腦斷層（肺窗）軸切面，胸骨後前縱膈腔可見軟組織密度腫塊（箭頭），往左側肺野突出並推擠鄰近肺組織，對應 PET 上的高代謝病灶。
features: Axial chest CT, lung window, upper thoracic level
Lobulated soft-tissue density mass in the anterior mediastinum behind the sternum (arrow), bulging toward the left
Mass abuts the anterior aspect of the mediastinal vessels and trachea
Right apical lesion with bubbly/cavitary lucencies and mild ground-glass/interstitial markings in the right lung
Soft-tissue detail limited by lung window setting
62596.describe_en: Axial contrast chest CT displayed in lung window demonstrates a lobulated soft-tissue mass in the anterior mediastinum (arrow), extending toward the left and abutting the anterior mediastinal structures. An additional right apical lesion with small air lucencies and subtle parenchymal opacities are present. CT localizes the mass and guides biopsy but cannot determine histology; lung window settings limit assessment of internal attenuation. In this transplant recipient the mass corresponded to EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder on biopsy.

62532.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，中央擴張的淋巴竇內充滿大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡嗜酸性，核圓形空泡狀、有小核仁，細胞質內可見小淋巴球；兩側為淋巴球與漿細胞密集的髓索，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Expanded sinus filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, ill-defined cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small distinct nucleoli and minimal atypia
Small lymphocytes and plasma cells scattered within histiocyte cytoplasm, suggestive of emperipolesis
Flanking cords rich in small lymphocytes and plasma cells
No necrosis, eosinophil-rich infiltrate, or mitotic activity evident
62532.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows sinuses markedly expanded by large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing small nucleoli. Scattered lymphocytes and plasma cells appear within the histiocyte cytoplasm, suggestive of emperipolesis, and the adjacent medullary cords contain many plasma cells and small lymphocytes. There is no significant nuclear atypia, necrosis, or eosinophilia. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease; confirmation requires S100 positivity with CD1a negativity in the histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytes are smaller, lack emperipolesis, and are S100-negative.
LCH shows grooved, folded nuclei with eosinophils and is CD1a/langerin positive.
ALCL cells show horseshoe nuclei with marked atypia and are CD30/ALK positive rather than bland S100-positive histiocytes.

62468.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭指出兩顆組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍綠色細顆粒狀，其中一顆邊緣可見一小顆紅棕色的被吞噬物；背景為大量深染圓核的晚期紅血球母細胞，呈紅系增生，符合溶血性貧血的反應性組織球。
features: Large histiocytes (arrows) with abundant, pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and a single oval nucleus
One histiocyte (right arrow) has a small reddish-brown inclusion at its edge, possibly an ingested red cell fragment or pigment
Left histiocyte shows a smeared, poorly delineated cytoplasm with a few darker blue granules
Background erythroid hyperplasia with numerous small round dense-nucleated normoblasts
Occasional granulocytic precursors and a basophilic/mast-type granulated cell at the upper right; dark stain precipitate present
62468.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia composed predominantly of late normoblasts. Two large histiocytes (arrows) are present with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and oval nuclei; one contains a small reddish-brown peripheral inclusion that may represent ingested red cell material or pigment, although resolution limits interpretation. Scattered granulocytic precursors and stain precipitate are also seen. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytes in the setting of increased red cell destruction, as in hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: HLH shows multiple histiocytes with clearly engulfed intact erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells together with clinical criteria, rather than a single equivocal inclusion.
Primary storage disorders show sheets of sea-blue or foamy histiocytes and require enzymatic or genetic confirmation.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse dark blue-black or golden-brown granules and is confirmed by Prussian blue staining.
CDA shows binucleated or multinucleated erythroblasts and internuclear bridging, which are not evident in this field.

62404.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色中黏膜固有層被大片密集、強陽性的淋巴細胞充滿，腺體上皮為陰性並被浸潤細胞包圍；在沒有生發中心結構的瀰漫 B 細胞浸潤中 BCL2 陽性，配合 CD20、CD43 共表現，支持黏膜相關淋巴組織淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）。
features: Dense diffuse BCL2-positive lymphoid infiltrate filling the lamina propria
Residual BCL2-negative glandular epithelium surrounded by the infiltrate
Focal positive lymphocytes within gland epithelium
Strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining of small lymphoid cells
No BCL2-negative germinal centers identifiable in this field
62404.describe_en: BCL2 immunostain shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate of strongly positive small lymphoid cells occupying the lamina propria and surrounding BCL2-negative residual glands. Occasional positive cells are present within the glandular epithelium. No BCL2-negative reactive germinal centers are identified in this field. These cells are reported to co-express CD20 and CD43; the findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: BCL2 stains normal T cells and mantle/marginal B cells too, so reactive cases are identified by BCL2-negative germinal centers, lack of CD43 co-expression on B cells, and polyclonality.
FL shows BCL2 within neoplastic follicles that co-express CD10 and BCL6 and carry t(14;18).
MCL is also BCL2-positive but co-expresses CD5 and cyclin D1.

62340.recognize_zh: 高倍下片狀不黏聚的腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富、核偏位並常有核周淡染區（perinuclear hof），細胞核大小差異明顯，上方可見多核巨大腫瘤細胞，並有深染核與核分裂像，符合退行性（anaplastic）漿細胞。
features: Sheets of discohesive large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Perinuclear clearing (hof) evident in a subset of cells, supporting plasmacytic differentiation
Marked nuclear pleomorphism with hyperchromatic, irregular and multinucleated giant tumor cells
Prominent nucleoli in some nuclei and scattered mitotic figures, including possible atypical forms
Focal collagenous dermal stroma in the center with a few admixed granulocytes
62340.describe_en: High-power view of the dermal infiltrate shows sheets of discohesive large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei, many with a perinuclear hof. There is marked nuclear pleomorphism, including hyperchromatic irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and multinucleated giant tumor cells, along with scattered mitotic figures. A small band of residual dermal collagen is present centrally. Findings are consistent with anaplastic plasma cell neoplasm involving the skin (cutaneous plasma cell myeloma), with immunophenotypic confirmation recommended.

ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei with strong CD30 and often ALK positivity, while myeloma cells are CD138/MUM1-positive with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction (note both can be EMA-positive).

Plasmablastic lymphoma shows more monomorphic immunoblastic cells, a starry-sky pattern and EBER positivity in immunocompromised patients, rather than bizarre multinucleated plasma cells in known myeloma.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters and is cytokeratin-positive, whereas these cells are discohesive with plasmacytoid hofs and keratin-negative.
Pleomorphic sarcoma cells are spindled to bizarre in fascicles or storiform arrays and lack CD138/light-chain expression.

62276.recognize_zh: CD57 染色可見大量散在的小型陽性 T 細胞，在結節區中形成較密集的斑塊，而部分圓形區域相對淡染；低倍下無法判斷是否有圍繞大細胞的玫瑰花狀排列（rosette）。
features: Numerous scattered small CD57-positive cells distributed throughout the field
Irregular zones of increased density of CD57-positive cells within the nodular areas
Rounded paler areas with fewer positive cells, likely corresponding to mantle-rich or interfollicular zones
Individual positive cells appear small with no evident large cell cores
Low magnification precludes assessment of rosettes around large cells
62276.describe_en: CD57 immunohistochemistry shows numerous scattered small positive T cells throughout the lymph node, with irregular areas of increased density within the nodular regions and rounded paler zones containing fewer positive cells. The positive cells appear individually dispersed without discernible rosetting around large cells, although this cannot be assessed reliably at low magnification. Increased CD57-positive follicular T cells can be seen in progressive transformation of germinal centers; the findings are consistent with PTGC in the context of the accompanying H&E, IgD and PD-1 stains.

ddx.vs: In NLPHL, CD57- or PD-1-positive T cells form rosettes around large LP cells, a pattern that requires high-power examination and is not evident here.

THRLBCL shows diffuse CD57-poor T-cell and histiocyte background with scattered large atypical B cells and loss of follicular dendritic cell meshworks, rather than a nodular follicle-based distribution.

62212.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見數個中大型原始細胞（blasts），細胞核一側有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核, cup-like nuclei），細胞質少且無明顯顆粒；此型態常見於 NPM1 突變合併 FLT3-ITD 的 AML。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm
Nuclear invagination producing a pale, clear indentation at one pole (cup-like / fish-mouth nuclei)
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved due to image blur
Single small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin for size comparison
Background red cells without obvious nucleated red cells; no Auer rods visible
62212.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm, and fine chromatin. Several blasts display a prominent pale nuclear invagination at one edge, imparting a cup-like morphology. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified, and image resolution limits evaluation of nucleoli. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: APL blasts have bilobed/folded 'butterfly' nuclei with fine cytoplasmic granules and Auer rod bundles, and PML::RARA is detected, whereas cup-like nuclei show a single invagination without granules.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear indentations but are MPO-negative and TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive, whereas NPM1-mutated AML blasts are MPO-positive, often CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with delicate folded nuclei and are NSE-positive, lacking the sharply demarcated cup-like invagination.

62148.recognize_zh: 多格組合圖：上排抹片可見漿細胞（箭頭），流式顯示 CD38/CD138 陽性漿細胞並輕鏈限制；下排抹片為成片單一形態小至中型淋巴球，流式為 CD19 陽性輕鏈限制 B 細胞；兩組 FISH 均顯示 IGH::CCND1 融合訊號，代表同一 t(11;14) 見於兩種淋巴腫瘤。
features: Smear with scattered plasma cells and plasmacytoid cells (red and black arrows) among normal marrow elements (A)
Sheets of monotonous small to medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm (D)
Flow cytometry of a CD38/CD138-positive plasma cell population with light-chain plots (B)
Flow cytometry of a CD19-positive clonal B-cell population with kappa/lambda and additional marker plots (E)
Interphase FISH with IGH/CCND1 dual-fusion probes showing fusion signals in both samples (C, F)
62148.describe_en: This composite figure pairs two lymphoid neoplasms. The upper smear (A) shows scattered plasma cells among marrow elements, and flow cytometry (B) identifies a CD38/CD138-positive plasma cell population evaluated for light-chain restriction. The lower smear (D) shows sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, and flow cytometry (E) shows a CD19-positive B-cell population with light-chain restriction; the plot labels are too small to read every marker reliably. Interphase FISH with IGH/CCND1 probes (C, F) shows fusion signals in both, indicating t(11;14)(q13;q32). The findings illustrate t(11;14) in a plasma cell neoplasm and in a CCND1-rearranged B-cell lymphoma such as mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5/CD23-positive with dim surface light chain and lacks IGH::CCND1, whereas mantle cell lymphoma is CD23-negative with cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
Morphology cannot separate cytogenetic subgroups; FISH identifies t(11;14), which is associated with lymphoplasmacytic morphology, CD20 expression and venetoclax sensitivity.
LPL shows a spectrum of lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than IGH::CCND1.
Non-nodal MCL is SOX11-negative and often CD200-positive with indolent course, while classic MCL is SOX11-positive, both carrying t(11;14).

62084.recognize_zh: 未染色的鐮刀化試驗濕片中，許多紅血球變成新月形、鐮刀狀或多角冬青葉狀，與未變形的圓形紅血球混在一起，代表檢體含 HbS。
features: Unstained bright-field wet preparation of red cells
Many red cells deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes
Admixed round biconcave red cells that remain unsickled
Variation in red cell size with some small cells
No nucleated cells or stained detail available for assessment
62084.describe_en: Unstained wet-mount sickling test preparation shows a mixture of round red cells and numerous red cells that have deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes under reduced oxygen conditions. The positive result indicates the presence of hemoglobin S but does not quantify it. Hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required to distinguish sickle cell trait from sickle cell disease; in this patient, the HbS fraction of 26.3% supports sickle cell trait with coexisting alpha thalassemia.

ddx.vs: The sickling test is positive in both; HbSS and HbS/beta0-thalassemia lack HbA on HPLC, whereas trait has HbA exceeding HbS.
Echinocytes are round with regular short projections, not elongated crescent or holly-leaf forms.
Elliptocytes are smooth oval to rod shapes seen on stained smears without the pointed ends and angular holly-leaf outlines of sickled cells.

62020.recognize_zh: 胸部 CT 軸切面可見左前上胸壁、胸大肌深層一顆巨大、邊界相對清楚的軟組織腫塊，內部密度偏低、較均質，旁邊另有圓形結節（腋下淋巴結可能）；巨大且快速長大的腫塊符合難治性雙重打擊淋巴瘤（double-hit lymphoma）的臨床脈絡。
features: Axial CT of the upper chest at the level of the aortic arch branches
Very large, lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left anterosuperior chest wall deep to the pectoral muscles
Mass is relatively homogeneous and hypoattenuating relative to muscle, possibly reflecting necrosis
Adjacent rounded soft-tissue nodule(s) toward the left axilla, suggestive of lymphadenopathy
Lungs clear; mediastinal vessels and trachea not displaced in this slice
Non-morphologic image: vascular invasion described clinically cannot be assessed on this single slice
62020.describe_en: Axial CT of the chest shows a very large, lobulated, relatively low-attenuation soft-tissue mass in the left anterosuperior chest wall deep to the pectoral musculature, with an adjacent rounded soft-tissue nodule toward the left axilla. The lungs are clear and the mediastinal structures are not displaced at this level. The low internal attenuation may reflect necrosis, as described clinically; vascular and thyroid invasion reported in the case are outside this slice. The imaging is compatible with bulky, aggressive lymphoma in a patient with refractory high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, but diagnosis rests on histology and FISH.

ddx.dx: Soft-tissue sarcoma of the chest wall
ddx.vs: Sarcoma is separated by biopsy showing spindle or pleomorphic mesenchymal cells negative for CD45 and B-cell markers.
An abscess usually shows a thick enhancing rim with central fluid attenuation and gas or fat stranding, and aspiration yields neutrophils and organisms rather than sheets of large lymphoid cells.
Carcinoma is distinguished on biopsy by cohesive cytokeratin-positive cells lacking CD20/CD45.

61956.recognize_zh: 高倍可見大量大型異型細胞，核偏心、呈腎形或凹陷，核仁明顯，細胞質豐富且空泡化，並散在嗜中性球、嗜酸性球與凋亡碎片，是ALCL大型多形性腫瘤細胞的典型表現。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric, reniform to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli (hallmark-like cells)
Marked nuclear pleomorphism, including bizarre and multilobated forms
Admixed neutrophils, eosinophils and apoptotic debris
Diffuse sheet-like growth
61956.describe_en: High-power H&E shows a diffuse proliferation of large pleomorphic cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and eccentric, kidney-shaped to indented nuclei containing vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, consistent with hallmark cells. Neutrophils, eosinophils and apoptotic debris are interspersed. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; ALK immunostain is required to separate ALK-positive from ALK-negative subtypes.

ddx.vs: Distinguished only by ALK immunoreactivity; morphology is indistinguishable in the common pattern.
HRS cells are CD15+ and weakly PAX5+ with loss of T-cell and cytotoxic markers, whereas ALCL is PAX5-negative and frequently expresses granzyme B/perforin/TIA1.
Histiocytic sarcoma cells are CD163/CD68/PU.1-positive and CD30/T-cell-marker negative.

61892.recognize_zh: 抹片中央一群大小一致、約 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小酵母菌，每個都有新月形紫色染色質帽並被透明暈環（halo）包圍，散佈於破裂的巨噬細胞附近，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Cluster of numerous uniform small oval yeast forms, approximately 2-4 um
Each organism has an eccentric crescent- or cap-shaped purple chromatin mass
Clear pseudocapsular halo surrounding each yeast
Organisms largely extracellular, adjacent to a disrupted macrophage, consistent with release from a ruptured histiocyte
No kinetoplast rod and no visible budding in this field
Background mononuclear cells and red cells slightly out of focus
61892.describe_en: Romanowsky-stained smear, probably a bone marrow aspirate, shows a large aggregate of small, uniform oval yeast forms measuring roughly 2-4 um. Each organism has a crescent-shaped basophilic chromatin cap and a surrounding clear halo, and the organisms lie largely free next to a disrupted macrophage, likely released from a ruptured histiocyte. No kinetoplast is seen and budding is not evident at this resolution; the image is somewhat out of focus. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection; confirmation by GMS/PAS stains, culture or urine/serum antigen testing is recommended.
