ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast perpendicular to it and lack the clear halo, whereas these yeasts show a single crescent chromatin cap and a halo.
T. marneffei divides by fission and shows elongated sausage forms with a central transverse septum rather than uniform oval budding yeasts.
Tachyzoites are crescentic/banana-shaped with a central nucleus and no halo, unlike these oval haloed yeasts.
These yeasts are larger or show a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow- or broad-based budding, rather than tiny uniform 2-4 um intracellular forms.

61828.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（非形態圖）：第 8 號染色體有三條（箭頭指出多出的一條），性染色體為 XX，其餘染色體數目與結構看來正常，即 47,XX,+8。
features: G-banded karyogram with chromosomes arranged 1 to 22 plus sex chromosomes
Three copies of chromosome 8 with arrow pointing to the extra homolog
Two X chromosomes, no Y chromosome (female)
No obvious structural rearrangement of other chromosomes at this band resolution
61828.describe_en: The figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows three copies of chromosome 8, with the extra homolog marked by an arrow, and two X chromosomes, with no apparent structural abnormality at this banding resolution. The karyotype reads 47,XX,+8. Trisomy 8 is a recurrent abnormality in myeloid neoplasms and is one of the most frequent acquired cytogenetic changes in patients with germline GATA2 mutation, along with monosomy 7.

61764.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（左下角可見骨小樑）被成片、單調的中型淋巴細胞取代，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，僅殘留少數巨核細胞；這種瀰漫性母細胞樣浸潤符合母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Hypercellular marrow replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular/indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant pale cytoplasm
Residual megakaryocyte and few scattered normal hematopoietic cells
Bone trabecula at the lower edge; few residual fat spaces
61764.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced, with an occasional megakaryocyte and a bone trabecula at the edge of the field. No paratrabecular or nodular pattern is evident in this field. With confirmatory cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD5 immunostains, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive and lack surface immunoglobulin and cyclin D1, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
AML blasts express MPO, CD33 and CD117 and are negative for CD20, PAX5 and cyclin D1.
Myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei with more abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and are CD138-positive with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction but CD20-negative.

61700.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀散佈圖（CD138 PC5.5 對 CD38 PC7），圈選的 CD38 強陽性、CD138 陽性族群佔活細胞 24.23%；大量 CD38/CD138 雙陽性漿細胞支持漿細胞腫瘤，但需再以 CD19、CD56、CD45 與輕鏈判斷是否為克隆性。
features: Bivariate dot plot gated on live cells: CD138 PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD38 PC7 (y-axis)
Large gated population (green) with bright CD38 and CD138 expression ranging from dim to bright
CD38+CD138+ events account for 24.23% of live events
Separate CD38-dim/negative CD138-negative populations (blue, gray) representing other marrow cells
61700.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on live events shows a distinct population with bright CD38 and heterogeneous dim-to-bright CD138 expression, comprising 24.23% of live cells. Remaining events are CD38-dim to negative and CD138-negative. A plasma cell fraction of this magnitude is markedly increased, although flow cytometry often underestimates plasma cells compared with morphology. Clonality and neoplastic phenotype (e.g. CD19 negativity, CD56 or CD117 expression, CD45 loss, cytoplasmic light-chain restriction) must be established on additional plots before concluding plasma cell myeloma.

61636.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色中，棕色陽性大細胞沿著分支的竇狀血管呈線狀、網狀分布，穿梭在陰性的造血細胞與脂肪空泡之間；這種 CD20 陽性細胞「描出血管輪廓」的圖型就是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Strong membranous CD20 in large cells distributed in linear, branching, anastomosing sinusoidal channels
Intervening hematopoietic cells and fat spaces negative
Positive cells outline vascular spaces rather than forming nodules or paratrabecular aggregates
Scattered single small CD20-positive cells in the interstitium
Hypercellular marrow at low power
61636.describe_en: CD20 immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy at low power highlights numerous large B cells distributed in a linear and branching intrasinusoidal pattern throughout the hypercellular marrow. The positive cells outline vascular channels and do not form nodular or paratrabecular aggregates, while the intervening hematopoietic cells are negative. This distinctive intravascular/intrasinusoidal distribution, which is often inconspicuous on H&E, is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: SMZL also shows intrasinusoidal CD20+ cells but they are small lymphocytes, often accompanied by nodular aggregates, rather than large atypical cells.
Conventional DLBCL forms diffuse or nodular extravascular infiltrates rather than a purely intrasinusoidal network.
HSTCL shows an identical sinusoidal distribution but the cells are CD20 negative and CD3 positive.

61572.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下整片是單調的中型母細胞，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯、細胞質稀少，可見核分裂像，正常三系造血消失；型態符合淋巴母細胞白血病，B 系與 BCR::ABL1-like 需靠流式與分子檢查。
features: Packed, monotonous sheets of small-to-medium blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
High N:C ratio with scant pale cytoplasm
Round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scattered mitotic figures and rare apoptotic bodies; no maturing myeloid, erythroid or megakaryocytic elements in field
61572.describe_en: High-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow replaced by monotonous sheets of small-to-medium blasts. The blasts have scant cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scattered mitotic figures are present. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage assignment (B-lymphoblastic) and BCR::ABL1-like classification require flow cytometry and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Blasts often have more cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, and are MPO/CD117-positive rather than TdT/CD19/PAX5-positive.
Cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with starry-sky pattern, near-100% Ki-67 and MYC rearrangement.
Cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and TdT-negative with CD5 expression.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and lack of B-lineage markers.

61508.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色中，大型上皮樣腫瘤細胞（卵圓或有凹陷的核、開放染色質）全部不染，只有穿行其間的血管內皮呈棕色陽性（內部對照）；說明髓樣肉瘤不一定表現 CD34，不能以 CD34 陰性排除。
features: Sheets of large epithelioid tumor cells with oval, indented, or reniform nuclei and vesicular chromatin
Tumor cells are completely CD34 negative
Strong CD34 staining of branching capillary endothelium, serving as an internal positive control
Moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
61508.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD34 on the soft tissue mass shows sheets of large epithelioid neoplastic cells with oval to indented nuclei and vesicular chromatin that are entirely negative. Branching capillaries within the tumor are strongly positive, confirming adequate staining. Because myeloid sarcoma with monocytic differentiation frequently lacks CD34, this negative result does not exclude the diagnosis. In conjunction with strong CD33 expression, findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is CD34 negative as well, but CD20/PAX5 positive and CD33/lysozyme/CD68 negative.
Carcinoma is keratin positive and negative for CD33, CD43, and lysozyme.
Histiocytic sarcoma expresses CD163 and CD68 but lacks myeloid blast markers and has no associated AML or blood/marrow involvement.
Melanoma can be epithelioid and CD34 negative but expresses S100, SOX10, and Melan-A.

61444.recognize_zh: BCR/ABL1 雙色雙融合 FISH：左上間期細胞見 1 紅 1 綠 2 融合（2F1R1G）；中期分裂相中標示正常 Chr 9（紅）、Chr 22（綠），以及 der(22)（Ph）與 der(9) 上各一個融合訊號，確認 t(9;22) 在費城染色體上。
features: Interphase nucleus (upper left) with two yellow fusion signals, one red, and one green signal (2F1R1G)
Adjacent metaphase with labeled chromosomes: normal chromosome 9 carrying a single red (ABL1) signal and normal chromosome 22 carrying a single green (BCR) signal
Fusion signals localized to der(22) (Philadelphia chromosome) and der(9)
DAPI counterstain (blue) of interphase nucleus and metaphase chromosomes
61444.describe_en: Dual-color dual-fusion BCR/ABL1 FISH performed on interphase and metaphase cells shows an interphase nucleus with two fusion signals, one red, and one green signal (2F1R1G). In the accompanying metaphase, the fusion signals localize to the der(22) Philadelphia chromosome and the reciprocal der(9), while single-color signals mark the normal chromosomes 9 and 22. Metaphase localization confirms a classic reciprocal t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). Findings are consistent with BCR::ABL1-positive chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase in this clinical context; quantitative RT-PCR is recommended for baseline transcript type and monitoring.

ddx.vs: Deletion of sequences flanking the ABL1 breakpoint on der(9) yields a single fusion pattern (1F1R1G) rather than 2F1R1G.
Three-way translocations and insertions give atypical patterns, and metaphase FISH shows fusion on a chromosome other than 22 or 9.
An additional der(22) produces three fusion signals (3F1R1G), a feature of disease progression.

61380.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，緊鄰骨小樑與血管處有一片由紡錘形細胞構成的纖維化病灶，細胞具淡嗜酸性細胞質、呈流水狀排列，邊緣伴隨淋巴球聚集，與周圍造血骨髓界線清楚，是系統性肥大細胞增生症的典型病灶。
features: Well-demarcated paratrabecular and perivascular aggregate composed of spindle-shaped cells
Spindle cells with oval to elongated bland nuclei and pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm arranged in streaming fascicles
Associated collagen fibrosis within the lesion
Small lymphoid aggregate at the periphery of the lesion (lower left)
Adjacent hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and eosinophils
61380.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a well-circumscribed paratrabecular and perivascular lesion composed of spindle-shaped cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma, with a small peripheral lymphoid aggregate. The adjacent marrow is hypercellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Findings are suggestive of systemic mastocytosis; confirmation by tryptase and CD117 immunostains demonstrating aggregates of at least 15 mast cells, aberrant CD25 (and/or CD2, CD30) expression, KIT D816V mutation and serum tryptase is recommended.

ddx.vs: Fibrosis is diffuse with streaming atypical megakaryocyte clusters rather than a discrete aggregate of tryptase-positive spindle cells.
Fibroblasts and epithelioid histiocytes are tryptase and CD117 negative, and granulomas contain multinucleated giant cells.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Fibrotic lymphoma foci contain atypical large CD30+ or clonal T cells rather than bland CD25+ mast cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic spindle cell tumor (sarcoma, sarcomatoid carcinoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show greater nuclear atypia and mitoses and express keratin or lineage-specific markers, not tryptase.

61252.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，在正常骨髓細胞背景裡可見數團明顯大於周圍造血細胞、緊密黏聚的細胞團（cohesive cluster），這種成團排列提示轉移性非造血腫瘤。
features: Low-power field with a few discrete, tightly cohesive clusters of cells larger than surrounding hematopoietic elements
Clustered cells show dense basophilic staining; individual cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification
Background of cellular marrow particle spread with trilineage hematopoietic cells and scattered fat vacuoles
Thick, dark, overstained particle/clump at upper right, uninterpretable at this power
61252.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread with scattered fat vacuoles and hematopoietic elements. Several discrete, cohesive clusters of larger cells stand out from the dispersed marrow cells. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification, and a thick particle at the upper right is not interpretable. In the appropriate clinical context, cohesive clusters are suggestive of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor; high-power review and correlation with the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry are required.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single large cells with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm rather than aggregates of discrete tightly apposed nuclei.
Osteoblasts form loose groups of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof, lacking true cell-to-cell cohesion and atypia.

ddx.dx: Clumped hematopoietic cells or marrow particle
ddx.vs: Particles contain mixed hematopoietic cells, fat and stroma rather than a monotonous population of large atypical cells.

61188.recognize_zh: 四格血液抹片中可見體積大的組織球（histiocyte），細胞質充滿空泡、細胞核被擠到一側呈新月形，形似印戒（signet-ring）；D 格組織球內含被吞噬的細胞，提示活化巨噬細胞，配合發燒病史應想到傷寒（typhoid fever）。
features: Large histiocytes (roughly 3-4 times the diameter of a red cell) circulating in peripheral blood
Nucleus compressed and displaced to the cell periphery, crescent-shaped, imparting a signet-ring appearance
Abundant pale blue-violet cytoplasm with vacuolation and a frothy, irregular border
Phagocytosed cell within a histiocyte cytoplasmic vacuole (panel D), consistent with hemophagocytosis
Low-power view (A) shows scattered large mononuclear cells among red cells, suggesting a buffy-coat-enriched or concentrated area
Accompanying lymphocytes and a neutrophil; no parasites or intracellular organisms resolvable at this magnification
61188.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered large mononuclear cells at low power. At high power these are histiocytes with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and eccentric, crescent-shaped nuclei displaced to the periphery, producing a signet-ring configuration. One histiocyte contains an engulfed cell within a vacuole, indicating phagocytic activity. No intracellular microorganisms are identified at this resolution. In the appropriate clinical setting of Salmonella Typhi infection, findings are consistent with circulating activated (signet-ring) histiocytes of typhoid fever.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and mucin vacuoles and are cytokeratin positive, whereas these histiocytes are singly dispersed, phagocytic and CD68/CD163 positive.
Histoplasma shows uniform 2-4 micron yeasts with a clear halo inside monocytes/neutrophils, which are not seen in these vacuoles.
Morphology is shared; separation relies on clinical/laboratory criteria (ferritin, sCD25) and blood culture or serology for Salmonella.
Monocytes have folded nuclei centrally placed with fine lacy chromatin and lack the large peripheral-nucleus signet-ring vacuolation and engulfed cells.

61124.recognize_zh: 低倍 kappa 原位雜交（ISH）中，整片皮膚浸潤幾乎沒有深紫色訊號，只有極少數散在陽性細胞；與同一病灶 lambda ISH 大量陽性相比，顯示漿細胞為 lambda 限制。
features: Scanning magnification of a skin biopsy with dense dermal infiltrate in pale counterstain
Very rare, isolated dark kappa mRNA-positive dots/cells within the infiltrate
No clusters or aggregates of kappa-positive cells
Edge darkening along tissue margins consistent with nonspecific edge artifact
Cellular detail not assessable at this magnification
61124.describe_en: In situ hybridization for kappa light chain mRNA on a skin biopsy, at scanning magnification, shows only rare isolated positive cells scattered within the dense dermal infiltrate, without aggregates of positive cells. Faint darkening along the tissue edges is consistent with edge artifact rather than true signal. Compared with the numerous lambda-positive cells in the paired stain, the kappa-to-lambda ratio is markedly skewed toward lambda. Findings support lambda light chain restriction of the plasmacytic component, consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Assay failure is excluded by an appropriate internal/external positive control and by the presence of occasional clearly positive cells here.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with kappa-positive cells outnumbering or approximating lambda-positive cells, unlike the near absence of kappa signal.
A scarce plasma cell population would be sparse on both kappa and lambda stains, whereas lambda here labels numerous cells.

61060.recognize_zh: 新亞甲藍（new methylene blue）活體染色下，大部分紅血球內可見深藍色網狀或顆粒狀殘留 RNA（reticulum），代表網狀紅血球明顯增加，符合溶血時骨髓代償反應。
features: Supravital stain with red cells stained blue-green
Many red cells contain dark blue precipitated reticular/granular RNA (reticulocytes)
Reticulocytes are a large proportion of the red cells in this field
Some cells appear small and round without inclusions
Scattered pale-blue platelet clumps in the background
61060.describe_en: Supravital (new methylene blue) stained peripheral blood shows numerous red cells containing dark blue precipitated reticulofilamentous material, identifying them as reticulocytes. Reticulocytes constitute a large proportion of red cells in this field, indicating marked reticulocytosis. Pale platelet aggregates are present in the background. In a patient with warm IgG autoantibody, findings are consistent with a brisk marrow response to autoimmune hemolysis.

ddx.vs: Heinz bodies on supravital stain are one or few discrete round inclusions at the red cell membrane, not diffuse reticular strands.
HbH inclusions (brilliant cresyl blue, longer incubation) are numerous fine evenly distributed dots giving a golf-ball appearance rather than a network.
Pappenheimer bodies are few small peripheral iron-positive granules seen on Wright and Prussian blue stains, not a reticulum.

60868.recognize_zh: B 圖抹片中的芽細胞中大型、核偏心、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍無顆粒並常呈偏向一側的「手鏡樣」突起；C 圖 TCL1 強陽性、D 圖 CD4 膜陽性，E 流式顯示 CD4+CD56+CD123 亮陽性的族群，符合 BPDCN。
features: Panel A (H&E biopsy): hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of medium-sized mononuclear cells with fine chromatin replacing normal elements
Panel B (aspirate): medium-to-large blasts with eccentric round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with tail-like/pseudopod projections
Panel C: strong diffuse nuclear and cytoplasmic TCL1 immunostaining of the infiltrate
Panel D: membranous CD4 staining of most infiltrating cells

Panel E: flow cytometry showing a distinct CD45-dim population with bright CD123 and CD4 plus CD56 and HLA-DR expression; a separate monocytic population is present, consistent with coexisting CMML (plot labels poorly legible)
60868.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow biopsy (A) is hypercellular with a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized blastic cells, and the aspirate smear (B) shows blasts with eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with pseudopod-like projections. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong TCL1 (C) and membranous CD4 (D) expression. Flow cytometry (E) identifies a CD45-dim blast population expressing bright CD123, CD4, CD56 and HLA-DR, alongside a separate maturing monocytic population; axis labels are only partially legible at this resolution. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, reportedly arising in association with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblastic AML can be CD4+/CD56+ but is lysozyme/CD11c/CD14 positive and lacks the TCL1, CD303 (BDCA-2) and TCF4 co-expression of BPDCN.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with CMML
ddx.vs: MPDCP forms nodules of mature-appearing pDCs that are CD123+ but usually CD56 negative and TdT negative, without blastic morphology or diffuse marrow replacement.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or NK-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: NK neoplasms are CD56+ but CD4 and CD123 negative, with cytotoxic granules and EBER positivity.
T-ALL is cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT positive and lacks bright CD123/TCL1/CD303 co-expression.

60868.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC: TCL1, CD4; flow cytometry

60804.recognize_zh: 八格組圖：胃黏膜固有層被瀰漫性單一形態的母細胞樣細胞擴張（A、B），腫瘤細胞在角蛋白（cytokeratin）染色呈核旁點狀陽性（C、G），易被誤為癌；但細胞學抹片為母細胞（F），其他髓系標記呈膜狀或胞質陽性（D、E、H），提示為胃的髓系肉瘤。
features: Panel A-B: gastric mucosa with lamina propria diffusely expanded by monotonous medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, separating preserved glands
Panel C/G: paranuclear dot-like cytoplasmic cytokeratin staining in tumor cells, with strong staining of native gastric glands as internal control
Panel D: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic staining of the infiltrate with a hematopoietic marker, glands negative
Panel E/H: double-stained sections showing dot-like brown cytokeratin with a red chromogen co-labeling the same cells
Panel F: touch/cytology preparation with discohesive blasts having round nuclei, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
60804.describe_en: Composite figure of a gastric biopsy shows lamina propria diffusely infiltrated by discohesive, monotonous medium-sized cells with fine chromatin and scant to moderate cytoplasm, surrounding intact glands. Cytokeratin immunostaining shows paranuclear dot-like positivity in the infiltrating cells in addition to strong staining of benign glands, whereas a hematopoietic marker shows diffuse membranous staining; double-labeling demonstrates coexpression in the same cells. A cytologic preparation shows blasts. The individual antibodies are not labeled in the figure, so marker assignment is inferred from the title. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma with aberrant cytokeratin intermediate filament expression, a pitfall for poorly differentiated carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells show strong diffuse cytoplasmic cytokeratin, mucin and E-cadherin loss, and are negative for CD45, MPO, CD33 and CD117, unlike the dot-like keratin in myeloid blasts.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of stomach
ddx.vs: Larger centroblastic/immunoblastic cells that are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO/lysozyme negative.
Also shows paranuclear dot keratin, but expresses synaptophysin, chromogranin and INSM1 and lacks myeloid markers.
Small centrocyte-like B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions rather than fine-chromatin blasts, CD20+ and myeloid-marker negative.

60804.stain: H&E; IHC: cytokeratin, myeloid markers; Giemsa

60612.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中聚集大量大型芽細胞：核大、染色質細緻、可見多個核仁，部分核呈凹陷或分葉狀，胞質灰藍並含細小嗜天青顆粒，偶見胞質泡狀突起（blebs），代表 AML 復發侵犯中樞神經。
features: Cytospin with numerous large blasts, tightly clustered, with high to moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei round to irregular, some indented, folded or lobulated (monocytoid/myelomonocytic appearance)
Fine, dispersed chromatin with one to several distinct nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and a perinuclear clear zone (Golgi) in some cells
Cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods at cell membranes, likely partly cytospin artifact
No lymphocytes or red cells to suggest traumatic tap in this field
60612.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows numerous large atypical mononuclear cells with fine, dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and irregular, occasionally folded or lobulated nuclei. The cells have moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules, with cytoplasmic blebbing. No significant peripheral blood contamination is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement of the CSF by acute myeloid leukemia, likely with myelomonocytic/monocytic differentiation, and should be confirmed by flow cytometry or cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive cells are a mixed population with mature chromatin and no nucleoli, not a monotonous population of nucleolated blasts.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant agranular cytoplasm and less nuclear folding; flow cytometry separates lineage.
Solid tumor cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with molding and lack cytoplasmic azurophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Blood contamination from traumatic tap with circulating blasts
ddx.vs: Contamination is accompanied by many red cells and blasts proportional to peripheral blood, unlike this concentrated blast population without red cells.

60676.recognize_zh: A 圖切片中大量腫瘤細胞核呈分葉、扭曲或切跡狀，乍看像成熟嗜中性球；B 圖抹片細胞具偏心核與深藍色胞質（與星號標示的真正嗜中性球比較）；C 圖核陽性染色（推測為 cyclin D1），支持 t(11;14) 漿細胞骨髓瘤的分葉核變異型態。
features: Biopsy H&E (A): sheets of cells with lobulated, cleaved, and twisted nuclei resembling segmented neutrophils
Aspirate (B): plasma cells with eccentric, irregular or indented nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing, contrasted with a true neutrophil (asterisk)
Panel C: strong nuclear staining with cytoplasmic background in the neoplastic cells (likely cyclin D1, marker not labeled)
Panel D: membranous positivity in the infiltrate (consistent with a plasma cell marker such as CD138, not labeled)
Panel E: cytoplasmic granular positivity in most cells; panel F: negative control-like staining (markers not labeled)
60676.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (panel A) shows a diffuse infiltrate of cells with lobated, cleaved nuclei that at low power can be mistaken for mature neutrophils. On the aspirate smear (panel B), these cells prove to be plasma cells with eccentric, irregularly lobated nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a perinuclear hof, distinct from an adjacent true neutrophil (asterisk). Immunohistochemistry shows nuclear positivity in panel C and membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in panels D and E, with a negative stain in panel F; the antigens are not labeled in the image. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with lobated (neutrophil-like) nuclear morphology, as described with t(11;14)(q13;q32)/CCND1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and MPO positivity, whereas these cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a hof and express CD138 and light chain restriction.
MCL is also cyclin D1 positive, but shows small-to-medium lymphoid cells with CD20/CD5/SOX11 positivity and lacks plasmacytic cytoplasm and CD138.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, high Ki-67, and frequent EBER positivity, rather than lobulated mature-appearing nuclei.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with fine chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm, and express CD14/CD64/lysozyme rather than CD138.

60740.recognize_zh: 周邊血淋巴球細胞質內充滿大小一致、邊界清楚的透明空泡（vacuolated lymphocyte），另一顆白血球含粗大深紫色顆粒（類 Alder-Reilly 顆粒），兩者並存提示溶酶體貯積症，本例為 GM1 神經節苷脂貯積症。
features: Small lymphocyte with a rim of cytoplasm packed with multiple discrete, round, clear vacuoles (A)
Lymphocyte nucleus mature with condensed chromatin; vacuoles confined to the cytoplasm
Leukocyte with coarse, dark purple-to-violet cytoplasmic granules and scattered small vacuoles (B), resembling Alder-Reilly-type inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely artifactual; no parasites or other inclusions
60740.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes with multiple sharply punched-out, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles around a mature nucleus. A second leukocyte contains abundant coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules with interspersed small vacuoles, resembling Alder-Reilly-type granulation. Red cells show crenation, likely a preparation artifact. In a child with neurodevelopmental regression, these vacuolated lymphocytes and abnormal granules are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder, consistent with GM1 gangliosidosis; confirmation requires β-galactosidase enzyme assay and GLB1 testing.

ddx.vs: MPS also cause vacuolated lymphocytes and Alder-Reilly granules, so separation relies on urinary glycosaminoglycans and specific enzyme assays rather than morphology.
CLN3 shows striking vacuolated lymphocytes but not coarse granulocytic inclusions, and is confirmed by CLN3 genetic testing.
Toxic granules are finer, confined to neutrophils with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, and occur transiently in sepsis rather than in lymphocytes.
These also produce lymphocyte vacuoles; PAS positivity (Pompe glycogen) or Oil Red O lipid and enzyme assays distinguish them.

captions: Vacuolated lymphocyte with multiple discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Leukocyte with coarse dark Alder-Reilly-like granules and vacuoles

60548.recognize_zh: 中央的淋巴細胞核不規則、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質中等量淡藍並帶少量細小嗜天青顆粒，符合大顆粒淋巴球；背景紅血球多呈狹縫狀中央淡染（口形紅血球樣），多屬抹片假影。
features: Medium-sized lymphocytes (center and upper right; one at left edge) with irregular, indented nuclei
Coarse, clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with a few fine azurophilic granules in the central cell
Red cells show widespread slit-like central pallor (stomatocyte-like), likely preparation-related
Scattered platelets; no blasts
60548.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with widespread slit-like central pallor, most likely a drying artifact, and adequate platelets. Several medium-sized lymphocytes are present with irregular, indented nuclei, coarse mature chromatin, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm; the central cell contains a few fine azurophilic granules. No blasts are identified. The lymphocytes have large granular lymphocyte morphology, and with a longstanding lymphocytosis and NK-cell immunophenotype the findings are consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells look the same but are surface CD3+ with clonal TCR gene rearrangement, whereas CLPD-NK lacks surface CD3 and TCR rearrangement.
ANKL shows larger atypical cells with nucleoli, EBV positivity, and a rapidly progressive clinical course.
Hairy cells have oval nuclei with spongy chromatin and circumferential hairy projections without azurophilic granules, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 B cells.

60484.recognize_zh: 組織中成片的大型多形性腫瘤細胞，核大且不規則、部分呈腎形或馬蹄形，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，可見核分裂像並夾雜嗜中性球；大型多形細胞中出現腎形核的 hallmark cells 是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的重要線索。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large irregular nuclei, some reniform/horseshoe-like (hallmark-cell type), with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Multinucleated and wreath-like cells and several mitotic figures
Cohesive growth that can mimic carcinoma
Scattered neutrophils and apoptotic debris in a loose edematous/vacuolated stroma
60484.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse, cohesive proliferation of large pleomorphic cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm. Nuclei are large and irregular with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, and occasional cells have eccentric reniform or horseshoe-shaped nuclei with a paranuclear eosinophilic region, consistent with hallmark cells; multinucleated forms and mitotic figures are present. Neutrophils and apoptotic debris are scattered in a loose, vacuolated stroma. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which should be confirmed with CD30 and ALK immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells with owl-eye nucleoli are scattered singly in a mixed inflammatory background rather than forming cohesive sheets, and are CD15+ and ALK negative.
Cohesive large cells in carcinoma/melanoma are keratin or S100/SOX10 positive and CD45/CD30 negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks ALK, whereas ALCL is B-marker negative with uniform CD30.
Histiocytic sarcoma has abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm but expresses CD163/CD68/lysozyme and lacks strong uniform CD30 and ALK.

60356.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD56 免疫染色：成片腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜環狀棕色染色，幾乎全部陽性；在母細胞樣浸潤中 CD56 合併 CD4、CD123 陽性，是診斷 BPDCN 的核心組合。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized tumor cells replacing marrow between scattered fat spaces
CD56: strong, crisp membranous (ring-like) staining with some cytoplasmic accentuation
Positivity in the large majority of neoplastic cells
Occasional unstained small cells and stroma provide internal negative contrast
60356.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD56 on the bone marrow core biopsy shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized cells with strong, crisp membranous CD56 expression in the large majority of the neoplastic population. Interspersed small cells and stromal elements are negative. Diffuse CD56 expression in a blastic marrow infiltrate that also expresses CD4 and CD123 is consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; CD56 alone is not specific.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or NK-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These are CD56+ but express cytoplasmic CD3epsilon and cytotoxic granule proteins and are usually EBER-positive, while being CD4- and CD123-.
Neoplastic plasma cells are often CD56+ but show plasmacytoid morphology and express CD138 with light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation or aberrant CD56
ddx.vs: AML may be CD56+ and CD4+ but expresses MPO, lysozyme or CD14/CD163 and lacks TCF4/TCL1/CD303.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (neuroblastoma, small cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: These are CD56+ but CD45-negative and express synaptophysin/chromogranin or keratin, forming cohesive nests.

60228.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見一顆核卵圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少而淡藍的母細胞（blast），緊鄰一顆佈滿粗大深紫色顆粒的嗜鹼性球；循環母細胞合併嗜鹼性球為t(6;9) AML常見的組合線索。
features: Single circulating blast with oval nucleus, fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent basophil with abundant coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus
No Auer rod discernible in the blast in this field
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic with few poikilocytes; platelets not prominent
60228.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with an oval nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, lying next to a basophil packed with coarse purple-black granules. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic. An Auer rod is not evident in this blast. In context, findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with basophilia, as seen in AML with t(6;9)(p23;q34); DEK::NUP214; bone marrow evaluation with cytogenetics is required.

ddx.vs: Features basophilia with a left-shifted granulocytic series and leukocytosis, and is defined by BCR::ABL1 on FISH/PCR.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocyte or large granular lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, lacking the fine blastic chromatin and high N:C ratio.
Lymphoblasts can look similar on morphology, so flow cytometry (MPO, CD13/CD33/CD117 versus CD19/CD10 or cCD3) is needed; accompanying basophilia favors a myeloid process.

60164.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中央有一顆巨大的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），細胞核呈多葉、彎折重疊的過度分葉（hyperlobated）型態，周圍是密集的顆粒球系與紅血球系前驅細胞，符合真性紅血球增多症（PV）骨髓增生的背景。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant pale granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobulated, deeply folded, overlapping nucleus
Megakaryocyte nucleus is mature-appearing with condensed chromatin; no small hypolobated or separated-lobe dysplastic forms
Densely cellular background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms)
Scattered small dense erythroid precursors (late normoblasts) among the myeloid cells
No increase in blasts evident in this field
60164.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent area with trilineage elements, dominated by maturing granulocytes with interspersed late normoblasts. A large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobated, folded nucleus is present. Blasts are not increased in this field and no dysplastic small megakaryocytes are seen. In the appropriate clinical context (elevated hemoglobin, JAK2 mutation), the findings are consistent with the proliferative phase of polycythemia vera.

ddx.vs: ET also has large hyperlobated ('staghorn') megakaryocytes but lacks the panmyelosis with erythroid and granulocytic hyperplasia; separation relies on hemoglobin/red cell mass and biopsy cellularity.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal-sized with normal lobation and occur without panmyelosis or a JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutation.
CML megakaryocytes are typically small and hypolobated ('dwarf') with marked granulocytic left shift and basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 is detected.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and high N:C ratio, forming dense clusters on biopsy, rather than mature hyperlobated forms.

60100.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色 CD45 dim 低側散射芽細胞群呈 CD34+、CD13+、CD33+、CD56 強陽性、HLA-DR 陰性，MPO 陰性（綠色顆粒球才是 MPO+ 對照），細胞質 CD41/CD61 相對陰性群有輕度右移；MPO 陰性加巨核系標記是 AMKL 的判讀重點。
features: CD45 vs SSC: blast population (red) with dim CD45 and low side scatter, separate from granulocytes (green) and lymphocytes (blue)
Blasts CD34 positive and CD13 positive
HLA-DR negative on the CD34+ blasts
CD33 positive with bright CD56 co-expression
Cytoplasmic MPO negative, with granulocytes serving as the MPO-positive internal control
Cytoplasmic CD41 and CD61 show a modest shift above the negative population, suggesting dim megakaryocytic antigen expression
60100.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow shows a distinct blast population in the CD45-dim, low side-scatter region. The blasts express CD34, CD13 and CD33 with bright CD56, are HLA-DR negative, and lack cytoplasmic MPO, while residual granulocytes show bright MPO as an internal control. Cytoplasmic CD41 and CD61 show only a modest shift relative to the negative events, so megakaryocytic antigen expression appears dim and should be confirmed with CD42b or immunohistochemistry. In conjunction with the morphology, the findings support acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Also MPO-negative CD34+/CD13+/CD33+, but lacks CD41/CD61/CD42b expression.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD56+/CD123 bright/TCF4+ and typically CD34-negative, unlike these CD34+ CD13+ blasts.
ETP-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7 with myeloid/stem markers but not megakaryocytic antigens.

60036.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的巨核細胞有大量淡紫紅色顆粒狀細胞質，細胞核卻分成三個互不相連、圓形的核（separated nuclear lobes），這種多核分離的巨核細胞是發育不良巨核細胞的典型樣貌。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular purple-pink cytoplasm
Three widely separated, discrete round-to-reniform nuclei rather than a single connected lobulated nucleus
Nuclei show moderately condensed chromatin without nucleoli
Platelet-type granules shed into the surrounding background
Single-cell high-power field; blast count and other lineages not assessable
60036.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and three widely separated, discrete nuclear lobes that lack connecting chromatin bridges. Platelet granules are dispersed around the cell. This form represents megakaryocytic dysplasia (multinucleated, separated-lobe megakaryocyte). Findings are consistent with dysmegakaryopoiesis, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the setting of increased blasts.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small cells about the size of a promyelocyte with a single mono- or bilobed nucleus, whereas this is a large cell with multiple separated nuclei.
Osteoclasts have numerous (often more than 5) uniform round nuclei with nucleoli and coarsely granular but not platelet-shedding cytoplasm.
Normal megakaryocytes show lobes joined by chromatin strands into a single nucleus rather than fully detached nuclear units.
The 5q- lesion typically shows small hypolobated or monolobated megakaryocytes, not multiple separated nuclei.

28740.recognize_zh: 胸水 cytospin 中出現大量大型原始細胞，染色質細緻、可見核仁、胞質嗜鹼帶小空泡且缺乏顆粒與 Auer rod，細胞間邊界清楚成群但非真正上皮黏合，形態上難分系列，需靠免疫表型確認為微分化型 AML。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Moderate deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with small vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs; no Auer rods
Occasional very large cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a peripheral pale rim
Blasts in loose aggregates in the inset (panel B) with discrete cell borders, mimicking cohesive clusters
Background of scattered neutrophils, lymphocytes, degenerating cells and few red cells typical of a fluid cytospin
28740.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows a cellular specimen composed predominantly of large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate amounts of agranular, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small vacuoles and blebs. Some blasts form loose aggregates with discrete borders, and scattered neutrophils, lymphocytes and degenerating cells are present in the background; cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are not seen. The blasts are morphologically undifferentiated, and in conjunction with flow cytometry (CD34, CD117, CD13/CD33 with MPO negative or <3% by cytochemistry) the findings are consistent with pleural involvement by acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form true three-dimensional cohesive clusters with cell-to-cell molding and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Mesothelial cells have dense cytoplasm with a lacy peripheral skirt, windows between cells and bland nuclei, and express calretinin and WT1.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and are TdT-positive with B- or T-lineage antigens, whereas myeloid markers define AML-M0.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or Burkitt lymphoma effusion
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are surrounded by lymphoglandular bodies and express mature B-cell markers rather than CD34/CD117.

20420.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中是一片單調、中等大小、核圓且有數個小核仁的淋巴樣細胞，其中散在周圍有透亮空隙、吞噬凋亡碎片的巨噬細胞（A，starry sky）與多個有絲分裂像（B），符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤/白血病。
features: Diffuse sheet of monotonous medium-sized cells, with nuclei roughly the size of a histiocyte nucleus
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and several small nucleoli
Scant amphophilic cytoplasm with cells appearing cohesive or squared-off against each other
Tingible-body macrophages with clear surrounding halo producing a starry-sky pattern (arrow A)
Frequent mitotic figures (arrows B) indicating a very high proliferative rate
20420.describe_en: Section stained with H&E shows effacement by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, multiple small nucleoli, and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Interspersed tingible-body macrophages with clear halos impart a starry-sky appearance, and mitotic figures are readily identified. No significant large-cell pleomorphism is seen. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia; confirmation with CD10, BCL6, near-100% Ki-67, negative BCL2 and TdT, and MYC rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger (nuclei exceeding a histiocyte nucleus) and more pleomorphic, with a lower and more variable Ki-67 and usually BCL2 expression.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can show starry-sky Burkitt-like morphology and is separated by BCL2 rearrangement and strong BCL2 staining.
Lymphoblasts have finer, more dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and are TdT positive, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT negative with multiple small nucleoli.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with t(11;14) and typically lacks CD10.

17732.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑之間有多個大小不一的類上皮肉芽腫（左上、上方、右下），被帶狀纖維化與淋巴球浸潤的基質包圍、彼此鄰近融合，未見乾酪樣壞死，符合類肉瘤病的多發性非乾酪性肉芽腫合併纖維化。
features: Multiple discrete, closely spaced granulomas between bony trabeculae
Granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; multinucleated forms suggested at top
No caseous necrosis identified
Extensive intervening fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and scattered lymphocytes
Normal hematopoietic marrow largely replaced in this field
17732.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows several compact epithelioid granulomas located between bony trabeculae, set within a fibrotic stroma containing spindled fibroblasts and scattered lymphocytes. The granulomas consist of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm without central caseous necrosis. Normal hematopoietic tissue is largely replaced in this field. Findings are consistent with multiple non-necrotizing granulomas with fibrosis, compatible with marrow sarcoidosis once infection is excluded by special stains and cultures.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas frequently show caseous necrosis, and AFB stain, culture or PCR is required to exclude them regardless of morphology.
Fungal granulomas show organisms highlighted by GMS or PAS staining and may contain necrosis.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than pure epithelioid granulomas.
Drug-related granulomas are usually small and loose and are identified by clinical history rather than a distinct morphology.

9924.recognize_zh: 這是未染色半固態培養基中的造血前驅細胞群落照片：BFU-E 是多團聚在一起的大型「爆裂」狀紅系群落，CFU-E 只是一小團緻密細胞，CFU-GM 為鬆散散開的細胞雲，CFU-GEMM 則是中心極為緻密的大型混合群落。
features: BFU-E: large multifocal burst composed of several coalescing dark (hemoglobinized) subclusters
CFU-E: small, compact, tight cluster of a few dozen cells
CFU-GM: loose, diffuse colony of dispersed refractile cells without hemoglobinization
CFU-GEMM: large colony with a dense, dark central core and a halo of dispersed cells at the periphery
Unstained in vitro methylcellulose cultures photographed by inverted light microscopy
9924.describe_en: This figure shows in vitro colony-forming assays of human hematopoietic progenitors grown in semisolid (methylcellulose) medium and photographed unstained. The BFU-E appears as a large multi-lobed burst of hemoglobinized subcolonies, whereas the CFU-E forms a small compact cluster derived from a more mature erythroid progenitor. The CFU-GM is a loose, dispersed colony of granulocytic and monocytic cells, and the CFU-GEMM is a large mixed colony with a dense center and peripheral spread. Colony size and complexity reflect progenitor immaturity: CFU-GEMM and BFU-E are earlier progenitors than CFU-E.

ddx.vs: BFU-E is an earlier, erythropoietin- and IL-3/SCF-dependent progenitor forming large multicentric bursts after about 14 days, whereas CFU-E forms small single clusters within about 7 days.
CFU-GM colonies lack red hemoglobinized cells and megakaryocytes, while CFU-GEMM colonies contain erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic elements, often with a dense reddish core.

ddx.dx: Cell clumps or debris in culture
ddx.vs: Artifactual clumps are present at plating and do not enlarge over serial days, whereas true colonies grow from single progenitors.

3460.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下組織被成片胞質淡粉紅的組織球樣細胞取代，其中夾雜成群的嗜酸性球（中央與右側的亮紅色細胞團），左上角殘存小淋巴球，這種「淡色組織球＋嗜酸性球」的組合提示蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-to-large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cell nuclei oval to reniform; grooves not resolvable at this magnification
Admixed clusters and aggregates of eosinophils, forming a dense focus in the center
Residual small dark lymphocytes at the upper left edge
Loose, focally discohesive architecture
3460.describe_en: Section shows effacement by diffuse sheets of histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei, with a residual rim of small lymphocytes at one edge. Numerous eosinophils are scattered throughout and form a dense aggregate within the infiltrate. Nuclear grooves cannot be assessed at this low magnification, and no necrosis or granulomas are evident. Findings are suggestive of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, to be confirmed by CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis, round nuclei without grooves, and are S100-positive but CD1a-negative.
Classic Hodgkin lymphoma contains scattered CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than sheets of grooved CD1a-positive cells.
These lack a sheet-like population of CD1a-positive Langerhans cells and often show necrosis or organisms.
Dermatopathic change shows paracortical expansion with Langerhans and interdigitating cells plus melanin-laden macrophages, without sinus-filling sheets and eosinophilic aggregates.

1412.recognize_zh: 成片圓形細胞的細胞核偏心、核周可見淡染區，細胞質呈強烈棕色免疫染色，外觀為漿細胞（plasma cells）大量聚集，符合漿細胞腫瘤；本圖本身並未顯示血小板功能異常，需結合臨床（副蛋白干擾血小板功能）解讀。
features: Sheets of round to polygonal cells with eccentric round nuclei (plasmacytoid morphology)
Strong cytoplasmic and membranous brown immunostaining in most cells, with a pale perinuclear (Golgi) region in some
Nuclei with vesicular chromatin and occasional small visible nucleoli
Dense, cohesive-appearing aggregates suggesting a marrow clot section or particle preparation
Antibody not specified; cytoplasmic pattern is compatible with immunoglobulin light chain or a plasma cell marker
1412.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant cytoplasm displaying strong cytoplasmic and membranous positivity, with perinuclear clearing in some cells. Nuclei have vesicular chromatin with occasional small nucleoli. The antibody is not identified in the image; if this represents a single immunoglobulin light chain, the sheet-like positivity would indicate a clonal plasma cell population. The image itself does not demonstrate platelet dysfunction, which in myeloma results from paraprotein coating of platelets and is assessed by functional assays. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma).

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular with a mixed kappa:lambda ratio, whereas myeloma forms sheets with light chain restriction.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes expressing CD20 and often MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of pure plasma cells.
Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and CD138/light chain-negative with more cohesive glandular or nested architecture.

1412.stain: IHC: marker not specified (cytoplasmic, likely light chain)

1348.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，脂肪空泡減少，散佈多顆大型的巨核細胞（megakaryocytes）且數量增加，背景有大量深色圓核的紅血球系前驅細胞；在 TTP 中這代表周邊消耗導致的反應性巨核細胞與紅血球系增生，本身不具特異性。
features: Hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with reduced fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes, scattered singly, with normal-appearing lobulated nuclei and abundant pink cytoplasm
Numerous small round dark nuclei consistent with erythroid hyperplasia
Maturing granulocytic elements present
No fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrating tumor evident in this field
1348.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with increased megakaryocytes that are dispersed singly without tight clustering or marked atypia. There is a prominent population of small cells with round, dark nuclei consistent with erythroid hyperplasia, together with maturing granulocytic elements. No infiltrative process is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive megakaryocytic and erythroid hyperplasia secondary to peripheral platelet consumption and hemolysis, as seen in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, and are not specific for TTP.

ddx.vs: ITP marrow shows similarly increased megakaryocytes but without erythroid hyperplasia or schistocytes, and ADAMTS13 activity is normal.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered, enlarged with hyperlobated or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei, often with reticulin fibrosis and thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS shows dysplastic small hypolobated or separated-nuclei megakaryocytes and dysplasia in other lineages.

2948.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑增厚、輪廓不規則且互相連結，骨小樑之間的髓腔被纖維性基質與出血取代，幾乎看不到造血細胞與脂肪，符合腎性骨失養症中的纖維性骨炎（osteitis fibrosa）變化。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with scalloped borders
Marrow spaces largely replaced by loose fibrous (paratrabecular and intertrabecular) stroma
Extravasated red cells within the fibrotic spaces
Marked paucity of hematopoietic cells and fat
Scattered spindle cells; osteoclast detail not resolvable at this magnification
2948.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces. The intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by loose fibrous stroma with extravasated red cells, and hematopoietic elements and fat are markedly reduced. Individual osteoclasts and Howship lacunae cannot be confidently resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa with marrow fibrosis, as seen in renal osteodystrophy due to secondary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin/collagen fibrosis with osteosclerosis, whereas osteitis fibrosa has paratrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and osteoblasts and normal megakaryocytes.
Paget bone shows a mosaic pattern of cement lines with very large osteoclasts, typically focal and with elevated alkaline phosphatase, without renal failure.
Desmoplastic metastasis contains cohesive cytokeratin-positive tumor cells within the fibrous stroma.
Reparative bone shows woven bone rimmed by plump osteoblasts in a localized site with a clinical history of injury or biopsy.

2820.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片整個視野只有紅血球，幾乎找不到血小板，也沒有血小板凝集或碎裂紅血球，符合單純的血小板減少；但單憑此圖無法確定是免疫性血小板減少症（ITP）。
features: Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with central pallor preserved
Platelets are essentially absent in this field; no platelet clumps are seen
No schistocytes, spherocytes or red cell agglutination
Occasional mild poikilocytes (teardrop-like or folded cells), likely smear artifact
No leukocytes present in this field
2820.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined in a well-spread area, shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant anisopoikilocytosis. Platelets are markedly decreased, with essentially none present in this field, and no platelet clumping is identified to suggest pseudothrombocytopenia. Schistocytes are not seen, arguing against a microangiopathic process. No leukocytes are present in the field for assessment. Findings are consistent with isolated thrombocytopenia, as seen in immune thrombocytopenia, although the morphology is not specific.

ddx.dx: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura / microangiopathic hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: TTP shows schistocytes and polychromasia with thrombocytopenia, whereas this smear has no fragmented red cells.
Pseudothrombocytopenia shows platelet clumps or platelet satellitism, typically at the feathered edge, which are absent here.
Inherited forms show giant platelets (and Döhle-like inclusions in MYH9 disorders), whereas ITP platelets are normal to mildly enlarged; no platelets are available here to assess size.
Marrow failure is usually accompanied by other cytopenias or circulating blasts, requiring CBC and marrow examination to exclude.

1284.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆大型組織球，細胞質淡藍而豐富，內含被吞噬的有核細胞與細胞碎片（hemophagocytosis），這是 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤常併發的噬血症候群表現。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated/foamy cytoplasm
Engulfed nucleated cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) and nuclear debris within histiocyte cytoplasm
Small oval histiocyte nuclei with fine chromatin, displaced by ingested material
Background of cellular marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors and red cells
Neoplastic lymphoma cells not clearly identifiable in this field
1284.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular marrow containing multiple enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm. Several histiocytes contain phagocytosed nucleated hematopoietic cells and nuclear debris, indicating hemophagocytosis. The background shows residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors; definite atypical lymphoma cells are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, which in a patient with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma supports lymphoma-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; marrow involvement should be assessed with EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical hemophagocytosis; exclusion of lymphoma requires EBER/immunostains and clonality studies rather than histiocyte morphology.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm without engulfed intact nucleated cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive histiocytes after transfusion or marrow stress
ddx.vs: Occasional phagocytosis of red cells or debris is nonspecific, whereas numerous histiocytes engulfing nucleated cells are more suggestive of HLH.

1092.recognize_zh: 單顆中型細胞，高核質比、染色質細緻、胞質只有一圈嗜鹼性邊緣，形態為母細胞（blast）；JMML 周邊血可見少量母細胞（通常 <20%）。
features: Single medium-sized mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly angulated nucleus with fine, open chromatin
Thin rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
No Auer rods identified
Adjacent large platelet; red cells with occasional crenated forms
1092.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine open chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm, consistent with a circulating blast. No Auer rods are seen. A large platelet is present nearby. In the setting of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, occasional circulating blasts are expected, but a blast count of 20% or more would indicate transformation to acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (e.g., with monosomy 7 or acute myelomonocytic)
ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts/promonocytes in blood or marrow, whereas JMML has fewer blasts with monocytosis.
Lymphoblasts may look identical; flow cytometry for TdT, CD34, CD19/CD3 and myeloid markers is needed.

1156.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，許多紅血球前驅細胞核周圍有藍色鐵顆粒圍成環狀，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast），配合血小板增多即符合 MDS/MPN-RS-T。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors with blue siderotic granules encircling the nucleus
Granules in a perinuclear ring pattern covering a substantial portion of the nuclear circumference
Ring sideroblasts constitute a large fraction of erythroid precursors in the field
Nuclear fast red counterstain; granulocytes appear yellow-brown with dark nuclear lobes
Scattered extracellular blue iron particles in the background
1156.describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring. Ring sideroblasts represent a large proportion of the erythroid cells in this field, well above the 15% threshold. Granulocytic cells are unstained. In a patient with thrombocytosis and an MPN-like marrow, findings support myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (formerly RARS-T), commonly associated with SF3B1 and JAK2 V617F mutations.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts (MDS-SF3B1) without thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: The iron stain is identical; separation requires a platelet count ≥450x10^9/L with MPN-type megakaryocytes for RS-T.
Congenital forms present young with microcytic anemia and no clonal myeloid mutations or thrombocytosis.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastosis (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc excess, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Reversible causes have supporting history or laboratory findings (low copper, vacuolated precursors) and resolve after removal of the cause.

1028.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆特別巨大的原紅血球（染色質細緻、胞質藍灰），周圍滿是大型原紅血球與棋盤狀染色質的紅血球母細胞，只有少數分葉嗜中性球，是紅血球系母細胞為主的骨髓。
features: Sheets of large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderately basophilic cytoplasm
A giant atypical erythroid precursor in the center with abundant cytoplasm and very large nucleus
Numerous maturing erythroblasts with coarsely clumped, checkered chromatin
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; rare segmented neutrophils
1028.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly erythroid-predominant population. Large proerythroblasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm are abundant, including a giant atypical form, and are accompanied by numerous basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts with clumped chromatin. Granulocytes are infrequent. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Giant pronormoblasts in parvovirus contain glassy intranuclear inclusions and occur in a marrow depleted of later erythroid stages, unlike the abundant maturing erythroblasts here.
Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly erythroid maturation with asynchrony plus giant myeloid forms, without a proerythroblast excess.
Megakaryoblasts and dysplastic megakaryocytes are CD61/CD42b positive, whereas erythroid cells express CD71, glycophorin A and E-cadherin.

4100.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下，黑色纖維在整個骨髓內密集交錯並呈流線狀排列，包圍成群的大型、核形不規則的巨核細胞，符合原發性骨髓纖維化的顯著纖維化（MF-2 至 MF-3）。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in black reticulin fibers with extensive intersections throughout the field
Streaming, parallel fiber bundles adjacent to the bone trabecula
Clusters of large megakaryocytes with pale cytoplasm entrapped within the fiber meshwork
Bone trabecula at lower left without appreciable osteosclerosis in this field
Few residual fat spaces
4100.describe_en: Reticulin stain of bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and focal streaming bundles, particularly adjacent to the bony trabecula. Clusters of large megakaryocytes are entrapped within the fiber network, and fat spaces are sparse. Collagen deposition cannot be assessed without trichrome stain. Findings correspond to at least grade MF-2 fibrosis and, together with atypical megakaryocytic clustering, are consistent with fibrotic-stage primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Fibrosis appears identical and requires a documented history of PV or ET to distinguish.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated or dysplastic megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than clustered large bulbous MPN megakaryocytes.
These show increased CD34+ blasts (≥20%) with abrupt onset, which require CD34 immunostaining to detect.

ddx.dx: Secondary fibrosis (metastatic carcinoma, hairy cell leukemia, mastocytosis)
ddx.vs: Secondary fibrosis is accompanied by an identifiable infiltrate highlighted by keratin, CD20/annexin A1 or tryptase staining.

4164.recognize_zh: 兩個子細胞各含一團緻密、分離的染色質，細胞質仍以狹窄橋樑相連、呈啞鈴形，是正在分裂末期（telophase）的細胞出現在周邊血液抹片中。
features: Dumbbell-shaped dividing cell with two daughter halves joined by a narrowing cytoplasmic bridge
Each half contains a dense, clumped chromatin mass without nuclear membrane or nucleolus
Moderate amount of basophilic blue cytoplasm
Nearby mononuclear cell with indented nucleus and blue cytoplasm (reactive lymphocyte or monocyte)
Background red cells with central pallor and scattered platelets; color cast of the photograph limits color assessment
4164.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cell in late mitosis (telophase), with two daughter cells each containing a condensed chromatin mass, separated by a narrowing cytoplasmic bridge with basophilic cytoplasm. A mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus and moderate blue cytoplasm is also present, while the red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Mitotic figures are rarely seen in normal blood and may occur in reactive states with circulating immunoblasts, in marrow stress, or in leukemic and lymphoma circulation. Findings demonstrate a circulating telophase cell; the lineage cannot be determined morphologically and correlation with the full smear and CBC is advised.

ddx.dx: Binucleated cell (e.g., reactive lymphocyte or dyserythropoietic normoblast)
ddx.vs: Binucleate cells have two nuclei with intact nuclear membranes within one continuous cell rather than condensed chromosome masses at opposite poles.
Overlapping cells show separate complete cell borders, whereas telophase shows a single constricted cytoplasmic bridge.

ddx.dx: Circulating blasts or lymphoma cells in mitosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic circulation would show additional blasts or atypical cells in the smear, which requires review beyond this field and flow cytometry.

3908.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的分葉核嗜中性球胞質裡布滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯得多，這就是毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）；旁邊還有胞質淡藍、貼著紅血球邊緣的反應性淋巴球。
features: Segmented/band neutrophils with coarse, dark purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation, arrow)
Granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm; no discrete Döhle bodies clearly seen in this field
Several large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm indenting adjacent red cells
Red cells largely normochromic with occasional small refractile artifacts
3908.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with coarse, dark purple-staining cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation (arrow), without a discrete cytoplasmic vacuole or definite Döhle body in this field. Several large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells are also present. Red cells show no significant diagnostic abnormality apart from drying artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes, suggestive of an infectious/inflammatory process or G-CSF effect.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark and present in all granulocytes (and often lymphocytes and monocytes) of a clinically well patient with mucopolysaccharidosis, not only in neutrophils during infection.
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular, fused granules rather than numerous small coarse granules.
Overstaining darkens granules uniformly across the whole smear including red cells, whereas true toxic granulation varies between neutrophils and often accompanies left shift and Döhle bodies.

3780.recognize_zh: 兩顆大小約紅血球兩倍的細胞，細胞核分成 3–4 葉、以細絲相連，染色質濃密成塊，細胞質淡粉紅色並有細小淡紫色顆粒，是正常成熟的分葉核嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Cell diameter about 2 times an RBC (approximately 12–15 µm)
Nucleus segmented into 3–4 lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments
Coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed lilac (secondary) granules
No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuoles
Background normocytic, normochromic RBCs and a few platelets
3780.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils. Each has a nucleus divided into three to four lobes connected by thin filaments, with coarse condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale pink with fine lilac specific granules, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolization. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets are present. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes (or >5% with 5 lobes), whereas these cells have 3–4 lobes.
A band has a continuous, non-segmented curved nucleus without thin filamentous constrictions.
Eosinophils are usually bilobed with large, refractile orange-red granules instead of fine lilac granules.

3588.recognize_zh: 淋巴球體積大，細胞質豐富、淡藍色，周邊顏色較深，邊緣被旁邊紅血球壓出凹痕；核卵圓、染色質略疏鬆，細胞質角落有少數小空泡。這是反應性（非典型）淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte, about 2 times RBC diameter, with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed, slightly open chromatin; no prominent nucleolus
Abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with deeper basophilia at the periphery
Cytoplasmic border indented by adjacent RBCs
A few small vacuoles at one pole of the cytoplasm
Adjacent normal platelets; RBCs normochromic
3588.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an oval nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant pale-blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasm shows peripheral basophilia, is indented by neighboring red cells, and contains a few small vacuoles. No nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical) lymphocyte, as in infectious mononucleosis or other viral infections.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections and a spongy chromatin pattern and are BRAF V600E+/CD103+/CD25+/CD11c+.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and grey ground-glass cytoplasm without peripheral basophilia.
Lymphoma cells are monotonous and show nuclear irregularity, nucleoli, and clonal immunophenotype, unlike this heterogeneous reactive cell.

3652.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球各階段成熟、紅血球母細胞散在，同時有不少小而圓、染色質濃密、細胞質極少的淋巴球／造血原細胞（hematogones），這種淋巴球比例偏高的組合符合兒童正常骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate with trilineage hematopoiesis and orderly granulocytic maturation
Relatively numerous small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes/hematogones)
Erythroid precursors at various stages with round nuclei and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Occasional larger cells with deep blue cytoplasm consistent with proerythroblasts/early precursors, not forming sheets
No clusters of atypical blasts or dysplastic forms
3652.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows trilineage hematopoiesis with orderly granulocytic and erythroid maturation. Small lymphoid cells, including lymphocytes and likely hematogones with scant cytoplasm and condensed homogeneous chromatin, are relatively prominent, as is expected in young children. Scattered early precursors are present without a sheet-like increase in blasts or dysplasia. Findings are consistent with a normal pediatric bone marrow aspirate.

ddx.vs: Shows sheets of monotonous lymphoblasts with finer chromatin and replacement of normal hematopoiesis, and flow cytometry shows an aberrant immunophenotype rather than the orderly maturation pattern of hematogones.
A quantitative increase of the same benign precursors, usually after chemotherapy or in cytopenias, distinguished from normal only by count and clinical context.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Forms cohesive clumps or rosettes of tumor cells with neuropil, rather than dispersed lymphoid cells mixed with normal hematopoiesis.

3524.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的數個紅血球內含成簇的不規則藍紫色小顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），其中一顆細胞質淡且顆粒散布較廣；背景其他紅血球只偶見單一小點，含鐵顆粒的紅血球即鐵粒紅血球（siderocytes）。
features: Several RBCs containing clusters of small irregular basophilic granules (arrows)
One pale red cell with more widely dispersed granules throughout the cytoplasm
Granule clusters located centrally or peripherally within affected cells
Occasional tiny single dots in other red cells
Mild anisocytosis; scattered platelets
3524.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisocytosis with scattered red cells containing clusters of small, irregular, basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (arrows); one pale erythrocyte shows more widely distributed granules. Occasional tiny dots are present in other red cells. These inclusion-bearing cells represent siderocytes, and an iron stain would confirm the ferritin/iron nature of the granules. Findings are consistent with siderocytes, as seen in hyposplenism, sideroblastic anemia, and disorders of ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Stippling granules are uniformly distributed throughout the cell and do not stain with Prussian blue.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single larger round dense inclusions rather than clusters of fine irregular granules.
Overlying platelets have a pale blue cytoplasmic halo around granules, whereas Pappenheimer bodies lie within the RBC without a halo.

3140.recognize_zh: 一群大小一致的中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，只有極少量淡藍色胞質且無顆粒，符合前驅B淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）的形態。
features: Uniform medium-to-large blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed, evenly stippled chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic blebs or tails
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules seen
3140.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of monotonous medium-to-large blasts with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Nuclei are round to oval with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and the scant cytoplasm is pale blue and agranular, occasionally forming small blebs. No Auer rods or granules are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD22, cytoplasmic CD79a, TdT).

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and are separated by flow cytometry showing cytoplasmic CD3 and lack of B-lineage markers.
Minimally differentiated myeloblasts may look identical but express MPO (by flow), CD13, CD33, and CD117 rather than B-cell antigens.
Hematogones show a maturation spectrum with more condensed chromatin and a continuous CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern rather than a uniform aberrant population.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, CD5-positive, and cyclin D1-positive, usually in adults.

3012.recognize_zh: 真皮內片狀的大型多形性細胞，核大、腎形或不規則並有核仁，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，其間散在小淋巴球、嗜酸性球與管壁增厚的小血管，符合 CD30+ 的原發性皮膚退行性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate dominated by large pleomorphic cells in sheets
Large irregular, oval to reniform vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and neutrophils
Thick-walled small vessels and collagen bundles within the infiltrate
3012.describe_en: Section of dermis shows a dense, sheet-like infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular, oval to reniform vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. Scattered small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and neutrophils are admixed, and thick-walled small vessels and collagen bundles course through the infiltrate. The epidermis is not included in this field. Findings are consistent with a large cell lymphoma of the skin and, with diffuse CD30 expression, ALK negativity, and absence of systemic disease, with primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Histology may be identical; LyP presents as crops of regressing small papules, whereas pcALCL is a solitary or localized nodule over 2 cm that persists.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL-LT is CD20/PAX5-positive with BCL2/MUM1 expression and lacks the strong uniform CD30 of ALCL.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous Hodgkin-like or reactive CD30+ infiltrates (e.g., arthropod bite, viral)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates have scattered rather than sheet-like CD30+ cells within a mixed wedge-shaped infiltrate, without cohesive clusters of large atypical cells.

2628.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue，紅色核對比染色）高倍下，數顆紅血球前驅細胞的細胞質內有藍綠色鐵顆粒聚集在核周圍、部分環繞細胞核，提示環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）。
features: Iron-stained aspirate with red nuclear counterstain; siderotic granules appear blue-green
Several erythroid precursors with coarse blue granules clustered in a perinuclear distribution, partially encircling the nucleus
Granules are more numerous and coarser than in normal sideroblasts
Large immature cells with fine chromatin and no iron granules (early precursors or blasts)
Scattered extracellular iron granules in the background
2628.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue and a red nuclear counterstain shows several erythroid precursors containing coarse, blue-green siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus, in some cells covering a substantial portion of the nuclear circumference, consistent with ring sideroblasts. Large immature nucleated cells lacking iron granules and occasional extracellular iron granules are also present. A formal count of ring sideroblasts as a percentage of erythroid precursors is required, as is correlation with the Romanowsky-stained smear for dysplasia and blast percentage. Findings are consistent with a sideroblastic process, supporting myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts in the stated context.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only one to a few small, randomly scattered granules, not coarse granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Alcohol-, drug- (isoniazid, linezolid) or copper deficiency-related sideroblastic anemia
ddx.vs: These show identical ring sideroblasts, so exposure history, copper and zinc levels, and lack of SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetics are required to separate them.
Storage iron lies in macrophage cytoplasm or extracellular fragments rather than as perinuclear granules within erythroid precursors.

2500.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群大型組織球樣細胞，胞質豐富淡染、邊緣有小泡突起，細胞核呈卵圓形並有摺痕與核溝（nuclear grooves），右側旁邊有嗜伊紅性白血球，這種組合是蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症的典型細胞學表現。
features: Cohesive cluster of large mononuclear cells with abundant pale lilac cytoplasm and blebbed borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with nuclear folds and longitudinal grooves
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; low N:C ratio
Adjacent eosinophil with orange-red granules at right
Background small lymphocytes
2500.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained cytologic preparation shows a loose cluster of large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and blebbed cytoplasmic borders. The nuclei are oval to kidney-shaped with delicate chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and characteristic nuclear folds and grooves. An eosinophil and scattered small lymphocytes are present nearby. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have round eccentric nuclei without grooves and often contain phagocytosed debris or vacuoles, and are CD1a negative.
Rosai-Dorfman cells are larger with round vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli and tight cohesion without grooved nuclei or accompanying eosinophils.

2180.recognize_zh: 低倍小腸黏膜：絨毛仍呈指狀但略短，固有層有淋巴漿細胞浸潤，黏膜下層可見脂肪與腺體；本視野未見腫瘤形成或透壁浸潤，只能作為背景黏膜參考，無法單獨診斷 EATL。
features: Small-intestinal mucosa with finger-like villi of mildly variable height
Lamina propria with moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
Crypts of normal-appearing density with goblet cells
Submucosa with adipose tissue and glandular structures at top of field
No mass-forming atypical lymphoid infiltrate or ulceration in this field
2180.describe_en: Low-power section of small intestine shows mucosa with finger-like villi of mildly variable height, crypts with goblet cells, and a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the lamina propria. Submucosal adipose tissue and glands are present at the top of the field. No ulceration, mass lesion or transmural atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified, and intraepithelial lymphocytes cannot be assessed at this magnification. The image is not diagnostic of enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma on its own and likely represents non-tumoral mucosa; correlation with the tumor sections and CD3/CD8 immunostains is needed.

ddx.dx: Normal or mildly inflamed small-bowel mucosa
ddx.vs: Preserved villous architecture without increased intraepithelial lymphocytes favors normal mucosa, requiring higher power and CD3 counts to confirm.
Celiac disease shows villous blunting to flattening with crypt hyperplasia and increased intraepithelial lymphocytes, which are not convincingly seen here.
MEITL shows sheets of monomorphic medium-sized CD8+ CD56+ cells with marked epitheliotropism, absent in this field.

2116.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞成簇排列，核圓偏位於細胞一端，胞質豐富淡藍呈泡沫狀，並可見與核分開的淡染區（遠離核的 hof），外觀像大型漿細胞但核染色質較細緻，這就是骨髓中的造骨細胞（osteoblast）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells, larger than plasma cells
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale to medium blue, slightly foamy cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Pale perinuclear clearing (Golgi zone) located away from the nucleus
Background of normal hematopoietic cells, including a neutrophil, lymphocytes, and platelets
